generic.Defined scope/population: Scored recovery candidates from the current scoring run, capped at the daily routing batch the subrogation unit can absorb.
generic.In-scope period: Candidates scored since the previous routing batch date through today's cut-off in the subrogation system.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every row carries recovery score, routing lane, jurisdiction, statute expiry date and parent claim number.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Published worklist row count equals scoring output less rows dropped for an existing open recovery file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Worklist export saved in the subrogation system with batch date, scoring run id and publisher name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Dropped duplicate or unroutable rows listed with claim number and drop reason on the batch record.
generic.Test population: All rows in the published routing batch plus the dropped-row exception list for the same batch date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero rows referencing a claim with an open recovery file and zero rows missing a statute expiry date.
generic.Exception handling path: Unroutable rows return to the Claims Analyst queue for rescoring before the next daily batch runs.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Batch accepted when the count reconciles to scoring output and short-fuse files sort ahead of the rest.
generic.Evidence location: Routing batch record and drop log held on the subrogation system worklist for the batch date.

steps.title: Pull the scored candidate queue from the payment/subrogation system
sop: Open the recovery scoring output for the current run in the payment/subrogation system.
Filter to candidates not yet routed and record the starting record count.
Confirm the scoring run id and model version are stamped on the extract.
Done when the unrouted scored candidate queue is loaded with a recorded starting count.
verify: Compare the loaded count against the scoring run output count.
Pass when the loaded count equals the scoring output count for unrouted candidates.

steps.title: Sort by recovery score and cap the batch at unit capacity
sop: Sort the candidate queue descending by recovery score in the payment/subrogation system.
Read the current daily unit capacity from the subrogation team roster.
Cut the batch at that capacity and leave the remainder queued for the next run.
Done when the batch is capped at unit capacity and the carry-forward remainder is retained.
verify: Check the batch size against the stated daily unit capacity.
Pass when the batch size does not exceed capacity and no candidate is deleted rather than carried forward.

steps.title: Drop candidates already carrying an open recovery file
sop: Join each candidate claim number to open recovery files in the payment/subrogation system.
Remove any candidate whose claim already has an open recovery file against the same adverse party.
Write each removal to the drop log with the claim number and the existing recovery file reference.
Done when no batch row points to a claim with an open recovery file.
verify: Re-run the open-recovery-file join across the trimmed batch.
Pass when the join returns zero matches and every removal appears in the drop log.

steps.title: Split the batch into auto-subro and complex liability lanes
sop: Tag candidates where both carriers are arbitration signatories as the auto-subro lane.
Tag disputed liability, uninsured adverse party and large-loss candidates as the complex lane.
Confirm every row lands in exactly one lane with no blank lane value.
Done when each batch row carries a single routing lane tag.
verify: Count rows by lane and compare the total to the batch size.
Pass when lane counts total the batch size with no unlaned or double-laned row.

steps.title: Stamp jurisdiction and statute expiry on every batch row
sop: Read loss jurisdiction from the claim record in the Claims management platform.
Derive the statute-of-limitations expiry for that jurisdiction and cause of action.
Write jurisdiction and statute expiry back to the worklist row in the subrogation system.
Sort the batch so files with the least statute runway route first.
Done when every row carries jurisdiction and statute expiry and short-fuse files sort first.
verify: Scan the batch for blank jurisdiction or statute expiry values.
Check the top of the sorted batch holds the shortest statute runway.
Pass when no row is blank and the shortest runway files sit at the top.

steps.title: Publish the worklist to the subrogation team queue
sop: Publish the capped and laned batch to the subrogation team queue in the payment/subrogation system.
Stamp the batch date, scoring run id and publisher name on the batch record.
Notify the subrogation specialist team that the batch is available.
Done when the batch is visible in the subrogation team queue with its batch record stamped.
verify: Compare the published row count against the post-drop batch count.
Pass when the published count matches and the batch record shows date, run id and publisher.

steps.title: Confirm routing acceptance with the specialist team
sop: Review the published batch in the subrogation team queue for lane accuracy and volume fit.
Reject rows that are misrouted or unworkable and state the reason on the drop log.
Confirm acceptance of the remaining batch on the batch record.
Done when the batch carries a recorded specialist acceptance.
verify: Check the batch record for a specialist acceptance entry and any rejection reasons.
Pass when acceptance is recorded and every rejected row has a stated reason.

generic.Defined scope/population: The tortfeasor and any additional potentially liable parties named on this single recovery file.
generic.In-scope period: From referral acceptance to the demand draft date, refreshed if new party information arrives.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Adverse party legal name, address, carrier, policy number and adverse claim number are all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Each identified party on the file traces to a source document such as the police or incident report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Police report, ISO index match and carrier confirmation stored on the file with retrieval dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Parties that cannot be identified are recorded as untraced with the search steps already attempted.
generic.Test population: All adverse party records attached to this recovery file including additional liable parties.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero adverse party fields left as unknown or TBD on a file advancing to demand.
generic.Exception handling path: Untraced parties route to a skip-trace request before the pursue-or-close decision is taken.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Identity confirmed when name, address, carrier and adverse claim number are each evidenced on file.
generic.Evidence location: Adverse party record in the payment/subrogation system with source documents in the claim file repository.

steps.title: Extract tortfeasor identity from the incident or police report
sop: Open the police or incident report in the claim file repository.
Capture the tortfeasor legal name, address and, for entities, the registered entity name.
Record any citation issued and the fault statement attributed to the other party.
Done when the tortfeasor identity fields are written to the adverse party record.
verify: Compare each captured field against the report text.
Pass when name and address on the record match the source report exactly.

steps.title: Confirm the adverse carrier and claim number by contact or ISO match
sop: Search ISO or the index service for a matching loss and adverse carrier.
Where no match returns, contact the tortfeasor or carrier directly to obtain the claim number.
Record carrier name, policy number and adverse claim number on the recovery file.
Done when the adverse carrier and claim number are recorded with the confirmation source.
verify: Check the adverse claim number format against that carrier's standard.
Pass when carrier, policy number and adverse claim number are all populated with a named source.

steps.title: Verify the adverse policy was in force on the date of loss
sop: Ask the adverse carrier to confirm coverage in force on the date of loss.
Record the confirmation, the effective dates and the limits available for the loss type.
Flag any reservation of rights or coverage dispute the adverse carrier raises.
Done when in-force status and available limits are recorded on the recovery file.
verify: Compare the confirmed policy period against the date of loss.
Pass when the date of loss falls inside the confirmed policy period and limits are recorded.

steps.title: Record the VIN, plate or property address linking the party to the loss
sop: Read the VIN, registration plate or property address from the report and inspection notes.
Match the identifier to the adverse party named on the recovery file.
Attach the supporting photograph or registration extract to the claim file repository.
Done when the loss item identifier is recorded and linked to the adverse party.
verify: Check the identifier on the record against the source photograph or report.
Pass when the identifier matches the source and is attached to the file.

steps.title: Flag additional potentially liable parties for separate pursuit
sop: Review the loss facts for employer, contractor, manufacturer or premises owner exposure.
Add each additional party to the adverse party record with the basis for its liability.
Set a diary action to develop identity detail for each additional party.
Done when every identified additional party is recorded with a liability basis.
verify: Cross-read the loss chronology for any party mentioned but not recorded.
Pass when every party named in the loss facts appears on the adverse party record.

steps.title: Complete the adverse party record in the payment/subrogation system
sop: Write name, address, carrier and adverse claim number into the adverse party record.
Replace any unknown or TBD placeholder with a confirmed value or an untraced disposition.
Confirm the record is linked to the parent claim in the Claims management platform.
Done when the adverse party record is complete and linked to the parent claim.
verify: Scan the adverse party record for unknown or TBD values.
Pass when no placeholder remains and the record links to the correct parent claim.

generic.Defined scope/population: All triaged recovery candidates in the current routing batch awaiting a pursue or close decision.
generic.In-scope period: Decisions taken within the referral service standard from batch receipt to disposition.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each candidate carries a disposition, a reason code where closed and a rationale note.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Pursue plus close dispositions equal the candidate count routed in the batch.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Decision note stamped with decision date, decider name and the net recoverable figure relied on.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Candidates deferred for more information are logged with the missing item and a review date.
generic.Test population: Every candidate in the triaged batch, including those deferred pending further information.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero candidates closed without a close reason code and zero left with no disposition.
generic.Exception handling path: Pursue decisions above the specialist authority limit route to the manager for countersign before action.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Decision accepted when net recoverable, collectability and statute runway are each addressed in the note.
generic.Evidence location: Disposition field and rationale note on the candidate record in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Compare net recoverable against the cost-to-pursue threshold
sop: Read the net recoverable and estimated pursuit cost from the candidate record.
Compare net recoverable against the published minimum-pursuit threshold.
Record the pass or fail result of the threshold test on the candidate.
Done when the threshold test result is recorded on every candidate.
verify: Recompute the threshold test on a sample of candidates.
Pass when the recorded result matches the recomputed result on every sampled candidate.

steps.title: Confirm adverse party solvency or collectability
sop: Classify the adverse party as carrier-backed, self-insured, uninsured or judgment-proof.
Check the Claims management platform and prior recovery history for known non-payers.
Record the collectability classification and the evidence relied on.
Done when every candidate carries a collectability classification.
verify: Check each pursue decision against its collectability classification.
Pass when no candidate is set to pursue while classified as judgment-proof without a stated reason.

steps.title: Check remaining statute runway supports demand and arbitration
sop: Read the statute expiry date stamped on the candidate in the subrogation system.
Compare remaining days against the unit standard cycle time for demand plus arbitration.
Flag candidates where the runway is insufficient for immediate escalation or close.
Done when statute runway sufficiency is recorded for each candidate.
verify: Recheck candidates set to pursue for a runway shorter than the standard cycle time.
Pass when every short-runway pursue decision carries an escalation flag.

steps.title: Assign a close reason code to every non-pursued candidate
sop: Select a close reason from no liability, below threshold, uncollectible or no coverage.
Write a one-line rationale naming the fact that drove the close reason.
Set the candidate disposition to close in the payment/subrogation system.
Done when every closed candidate carries a reason code and a rationale.
verify: Filter closed candidates for a blank reason code or rationale.
Pass when the filter returns zero rows.

steps.title: Route above-authority pursue decisions to the manager
sop: Compare the expected recoverable on each pursue candidate to the specialist authority limit.
Route candidates above the limit for manager countersign before any referral advances.
Record the countersign outcome and date on the candidate record.
Done when every above-limit pursue candidate holds a recorded countersign.
verify: List pursue candidates above the authority limit and check for countersign entries.
Pass when every listed candidate holds a recorded countersign.

steps.title: Post dispositions back to the claim record
sop: Write each pursue or close disposition to the parent claim in the Claims management platform.
Confirm the claim shows the subrogation outcome so the adjuster sees it on the file.
Reconcile the disposition count to the candidates routed in the batch.
Done when every candidate disposition is visible on its parent claim.
verify: Compare disposition count on claims against the batch candidate count.
Pass when the two counts agree with no candidate left undisposed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Recovery candidates screened for fraud red flags before referral to the subrogation unit.
generic.In-scope period: Screening completed before referral, with SIU referral raised within 48 hours of any trigger.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Red flag checklist result, SIU referral reference and SIU disposition are recorded on the file.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Files with a ticked red flag equal the count of SIU referral references raised.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Completed red flag checklist stored with screening date and screener name on the claim file.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Red flags cleared without SIU referral are logged with the clearing rationale and reviewer.
generic.Test population: All candidate files screened in the period, including those with no red flag ticked.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero demands issued on files with an open unresolved SIU referral.
generic.Exception handling path: Open SIU reviews suspend demand and recovery payment until the SIU disposition is recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Screening accepted when every checklist line is answered and any trigger holds an SIU reference.
generic.Evidence location: Red flag checklist and SIU reference on the claim record in the Claims management platform.

steps.title: Run the red flag checklist against the loss facts
sop: Open the loss description and adjuster notes in the Claims management platform.
Answer each red flag line covering staged-loss pattern, late reporting and repeat parties.
Record the answer and the supporting fact for any ticked flag.
Done when every red flag line is answered on the claim record.
verify: Scan the checklist for unanswered lines.
Pass when no line is blank and each ticked flag names a supporting fact.

steps.title: Cross-check the adverse party and repair vendor across open recovery files
sop: Search open recovery files for the same adverse party name, address or repair vendor.
List any matches with claim number and loss date for pattern review.
Attach the match list to the claim file repository as screening evidence.
Done when the cross-file match list is attached to the claim.
verify: Re-run the search for the adverse party and vendor after the list is attached.
Pass when the attached list contains every match the search returns.

steps.title: Raise the SIU referral within 48 hours of the trigger
sop: Raise the SIU referral for any file where a red flag was ticked.
Attach the completed checklist and the cross-file match list to the referral.
Capture the SIU reference number on the recovery file.
Done when the SIU reference number is recorded against the claim.
verify: Compare the referral raised timestamp against the trigger date.
Pass when the referral was raised within 48 hours and holds an SIU reference.

steps.title: Suspend demand and recovery payment while SIU review is open
sop: Set the recovery file status to SIU hold in the Claims management platform.
Block demand issue and any recovery disbursement while the hold is active.
Notify the assigned specialist that the file is suspended and why.
Done when the file shows an active SIU hold blocking demand and payment.
verify: Check for demands or payments raised after the hold date.
Pass when no demand or payment exists on a file with an active SIU hold.

steps.title: Record the SIU disposition on the recovery file
sop: Obtain the SIU disposition of substantiated, unsubstantiated or inconclusive.
Record the disposition, the date and the SIU investigator name on the claim record.
Attach the SIU closing summary to the claim file repository.
Done when the SIU disposition and closing summary are on the claim.
verify: Check every raised SIU reference for a recorded disposition or an open status.
Pass when no closed SIU referral is left without a recorded disposition.

steps.title: Resume or close the recovery pursuit on the SIU outcome
sop: Lift the SIU hold where the referral is unsubstantiated and resume the recovery workflow.
Close the recovery pursuit with a fraud reason code where the referral is substantiated.
Record the resume or close decision with the SIU reference cited.
Done when the file is either resumed or closed with the SIU reference cited.
verify: List files with a closed SIU referral and check each has resumed or closed.
Pass when no file with a closed SIU referral remains on hold.

generic.Defined scope/population: Paid claims and recovery referrals for the reporting period across every line of business.
generic.In-scope period: The completed reporting month with the prior period shown for trend comparison.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Referral rate, leakage estimate, trigger source split and cycle time are each populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Paid claim count in the report reconciles to the warehouse paid claims count for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report version, data cut-off date and author recorded on the face of the detection metrics pack.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Metrics that could not be produced are listed with the data gap and the fix owner.
generic.Test population: All paid claims closed in the period plus all recovery referrals raised in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Top three missed-recovery patterns each carry a named remediation owner and a due date.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled populations are escalated to the data owner before the report is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Report accepted when referral rate, leakage and remediation owners are all present and reconciled.
generic.Evidence location: Detection metrics pack stored against the reporting period in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Extract paid claims and referrals from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Run the paid claims and recovery referral extracts for the period from the warehouse.
Record the run parameters, cut-off date and row counts on the extract.
Reconcile the paid claim count to the claims ledger control total.
Done when both extracts are saved with parameters and a reconciled paid claim count.
verify: Compare the extract paid claim count to the ledger control total.
Pass when the two counts agree or the difference is explained on the extract.

steps.title: Compute referral rate by line of business
sop: Divide recovery referrals raised by paid claims for each line of business.
Show the prior period rate alongside for trend comparison.
Record the numerator and denominator so the rate can be re-derived.
Done when referral rate is computed and shown by line of business.
verify: Recompute the rate for one line of business from the stated numerator and denominator.
Pass when the recomputed rate matches the reported figure.

steps.title: Quantify missed-recovery leakage from closed-paid claims
sop: Select closed-paid claims that met a trigger rule but hold no recovery referral.
Sum the paid amount on those claims as the leakage estimate at risk.
Split the estimate between statute-lapsed and still-actionable claims.
Done when the leakage estimate is quantified and split by actionability.
verify: Sample five leakage claims and confirm each met a trigger and holds no referral.
Pass when all five sampled claims meet both conditions.

steps.title: Break detection out by trigger source
sop: Classify each referral by source of automated rule, adjuster referral or manual file scan.
Show detection volume and leakage share for each source channel.
Identify the channel with the highest miss rate in the period.
Done when detection and leakage are shown per trigger source.
verify: Check the source counts total the referral volume for the period.
Pass when the source split totals the reported referral volume.

steps.title: Report referral-to-open cycle time and short-fuse volume
sop: Compute average and median days from referral raised to recovery file opened.
Count files referred with under 90 days of statute runway remaining.
Show both measures against the prior period in the metrics pack.
Done when cycle time and short-fuse counts appear in the pack.
verify: Recompute cycle time on a sample of ten referrals.
Pass when the sampled recomputation is consistent with the reported average.

steps.title: Assign remediation owners to the top three missed-recovery patterns
sop: Review the leakage root causes with the analyst and rank the top three patterns.
Name an accountable owner and a due date for each remediation action.
Record the actions on the metrics pack and on the recovery improvement log.
Done when each of the top three patterns holds a named owner and due date.
verify: Check each of the top three patterns for an owner and a due date.
Pass when all three carry both an owner and a due date.

steps.title: Publish the detection metrics report for the period
sop: Stamp the report version, data cut-off date and author on the pack.
Publish the pack against the reporting period in the payment/subrogation system.
Notify the unit manager and the referring claims teams that it is available.
Done when the versioned pack is published against the reporting period.
verify: Open the published pack and check version, cut-off date and author are present.
Pass when all three are stamped and the pack is retrievable for the period.

generic.Defined scope/population: All claims with a loss payment made in the period, run through the subrogation trigger rule set.
generic.In-scope period: Paid claims closed in the current run window since the previous trigger-rule execution.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every evaluated claim carries a trigger result, rule set version and evaluation timestamp.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Input population count equals paid claims closed in the period with no claim skipped.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Run log retained with rule version, input count, candidates produced and execution timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rule-engine failures and unscored claims are queued for manual review with the failure reason.
generic.Test population: All newly paid claims in the run window plus the manual review exception queue.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero paid claims in the period without a trigger-rule evaluation result.
generic.Exception handling path: Unscored claims route to the manual review queue rather than being dropped from the run.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Run accepted when the rule version matches the approved calibration and the population reconciles.
generic.Evidence location: Trigger-rule run log held in the payment/subrogation system for the run date.

steps.title: Confirm the rule set version matches the approved calibration
sop: Read the rule set version currently deployed in the payment/subrogation system.
Compare it against the latest approved calibration record and approver name.
Halt the run if the versions differ and escalate to the calibration owner.
Done when the deployed rule version is confirmed against the approved calibration.
verify: Check the deployed version string against the calibration approval record.
Pass when the two version strings match exactly.

steps.title: Assemble the paid claims input population from the warehouse
sop: Extract claims with a loss payment closed in the run window from the data warehouse.
Record the input row count and the run window dates on the run log.
Reconcile the count against the claims ledger paid-claim total for the window.
Done when the input population is assembled with a reconciled row count.
verify: Compare the input count to the ledger paid-claim total for the window.
Pass when the counts agree or the difference is explained on the run log.

steps.title: Execute the subrogation trigger rules across the population
sop: Run triggers for adverse-vehicle present and third-party property damage indicators.
Run triggers for product and premises liability and no-fault or med-pay lien indicators.
Capture the candidate output with the rule that fired on each claim.
Done when every trigger family has executed and produced a candidate output.
verify: Check each trigger family appears in the run log with an execution status.
Pass when all four trigger families show a completed execution status.

steps.title: Reconcile evaluated claims against the input population
sop: Compare evaluated claim count to the input population count.
List any claim in the input with no evaluation result recorded.
Investigate and re-run the missing claims before closing the run.
Done when evaluated claims equal the input population with no gaps.
verify: Re-run the missing-claim comparison after any re-run.
Pass when the comparison returns zero unevaluated claims.

steps.title: Route rule failures and unscored claims to manual review
sop: Collect claims where the rule engine errored or produced no score.
Queue each to the manual review exception queue with the failure reason.
Set a review diary so the queue is worked before the next run.
Done when every failed or unscored claim sits in the manual review queue.
verify: Compare the failure count in the run log to the manual review queue additions.
Pass when every logged failure has a matching manual review queue entry.

steps.title: Write candidate flags back to the claim record
sop: Post the subrogation candidate flag to each claim in the Claims management platform.
Include the rule that fired and the evaluation timestamp on the flag.
Confirm the adjuster view shows the flag on the claim file.
Done when candidate flags are visible on the claim records in the claims platform.
verify: Open a sample of flagged claims in the claims platform.
Pass when each sampled claim shows the flag with rule and timestamp.

steps.title: Close the run log with population and candidate counts
sop: Record input population, candidates produced, failures and rule version on the run log.
Stamp the execution timestamp and the operator name.
Publish the run log against the run date in the payment/subrogation system.
Done when the completed run log is published for the run date.
verify: Open the published run log and check all counts and the rule version are present.
Pass when the log shows population, candidates, failures, version and timestamp.

generic.Defined scope/population: The batch of open and closed claim files selected for manual recovery indicator scanning.
generic.In-scope period: Files paid or closed within the scan window agreed for the current review cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each scanned file carries an indicator found or not-found flag with a document reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Files flagged equals files scanned with no file left without a scan outcome.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scan outcome recorded with scan date, scanner name and the source document reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Files that cannot be scanned for missing documents are logged with a document chase action.
generic.Test population: Every file in the scan batch including files returning a not-found outcome.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero scanned files without a found or not-found flag and a document reference.
generic.Exception handling path: Files missing key documents route to a document retrieval action before rescan.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Scan accepted when notes, report, estimate and lien checks are each evidenced on the file.
generic.Evidence location: Indicator flag on the claim record with source documents in the claim file repository.

steps.title: Build the scan batch in the Claims management platform
sop: Select open and closed claims inside the scan window with a loss payment recorded.
Exclude claims already carrying an open recovery file from the batch.
Record the batch size and the scan window dates on the batch record.
Done when the scan batch is built with a recorded size and window.
verify: Check the batch for claims with an existing open recovery file.
Pass when no batch claim already carries an open recovery file.

steps.title: Read loss description and adjuster notes for third-party fault language
sop: Open the loss description and full adjuster note history on each batch claim.
Look for fault language naming another driver, owner, contractor or manufacturer.
Record the quoted note reference where fault language is found.
Done when every batch claim has had its notes read and the outcome recorded.
verify: Check each batch claim for a recorded notes-read outcome.
Pass when no batch claim lacks a notes-read outcome.

steps.title: Check the police or incident report for a cited party
sop: Retrieve the police or incident report from the claim file repository.
Check whether another party was cited or a fault statement was recorded.
Record the report reference and the cited party where present.
Done when the report check outcome is recorded on each claim with a report on file.
verify: Compare the recorded cited party against the report text on a sample.
Pass when the recorded party matches the report on every sampled claim.

steps.title: Review the repair estimate or appraisal for third-party impact damage
sop: Open the repair estimate or appraisal held in the claim file repository.
Check the damage described is consistent with an external impact or third-party cause.
Record the estimate reference and the damage consistency conclusion.
Done when the estimate review conclusion is recorded on each claim.
verify: Check claims flagged as indicator found hold an estimate reference.
Pass when every found flag driven by damage pattern cites an estimate reference.

steps.title: Check for lien, med-pay or workers-compensation offsets
sop: Review payment components for med-pay, no-fault or workers-compensation elements.
Identify any statutory lien or reimbursement route arising from those components.
Record the offset route and the supporting payment line reference.
Done when offset routes are recorded for every claim carrying such payment components.
verify: Cross-check claims with med-pay payments for a recorded offset conclusion.
Pass when every med-pay claim carries an offset conclusion.

steps.title: Record the indicator flag with a document reference on each file
sop: Set the recovery indicator flag to found or not found on each scanned claim.
Attach the supporting document reference to every found flag.
Reconcile flagged files to the batch size and close the scan record.
Done when every batch file carries a flag and the counts reconcile.
verify: Compare flagged file count to batch size and check found flags for references.
Pass when counts reconcile and every found flag cites a document reference.

generic.Defined scope/population: All trigger-rule candidates awaiting a recovery likelihood and net value score for the current batch.
generic.In-scope period: Candidates produced by the trigger run for the current scoring window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every candidate carries a numeric recovery score, a score band and the scoring model version.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Scored candidate count equals the candidate count produced by the trigger-rule run.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scoring batch saved with model version, run timestamp and the sampling review outcome.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Candidates that fail to score are logged with the missing input and routed to manual review.
generic.Test population: All candidates in the scoring batch plus the top and bottom decile sample reviewed by the specialist.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero candidates auto-closed from a score band other than low.
generic.Exception handling path: Unscorable candidates route to specialist manual review rather than defaulting to auto-close.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Batch accepted when the decile sample agrees with specialist judgement and every candidate is banded.
generic.Evidence location: Scoring batch record and decile review note in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Assemble scoring inputs from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Pull paid indemnity, deductible, jurisdiction, statute date and adverse carrier presence per candidate.
Flag candidates missing any required input rather than defaulting the value.
Record the input row count against the trigger-run candidate count.
Done when scoring inputs are assembled with missing-input candidates flagged.
verify: Compare input rows to trigger-run candidates.
Pass when the counts agree and every gap is flagged rather than defaulted.

steps.title: Compute expected net recovery per candidate
sop: Add paid indemnity and deductible to form the gross recoverable base.
Multiply by the liability probability and subtract the estimated pursuit cost.
Store the computed expected net recovery on the candidate record.
Done when every candidate holds a computed expected net recovery.
verify: Recompute expected net recovery on a sample of ten candidates by hand.
Pass when the hand calculation matches the stored figure on all ten.

steps.title: Weight the score for adverse carrier presence
sop: Apply the carrier-backed uplift where an adverse carrier is confirmed on the candidate.
Apply no uplift where the adverse party is uninsured or unidentified.
Record the weighting applied so the score can be re-derived.
Done when the carrier weighting is applied and recorded on every candidate.
verify: Compare scores of carrier-backed and uninsured candidates with similar gross values.
Pass when carrier-backed candidates score above comparable uninsured candidates.

steps.title: Penalise short statute runway and missing documentation
sop: Apply the penalty factor where statute runway is under 180 days.
Apply the documentation penalty where loss documentation is absent from the claim file.
Record each penalty applied against the candidate score.
Done when penalties are applied and recorded for all qualifying candidates.
verify: Filter candidates with under 180 days runway and check for a recorded penalty.
Pass when every short-runway candidate shows the penalty applied.

steps.title: Assign the score band that drives routing
sop: Map each score to a high, medium or low band using the published band cut-offs.
Set routing to auto-refer, manual review or auto-close from the assigned band.
Confirm no candidate routes to auto-close from a band above low.
Done when every candidate carries a band and a matching routing outcome.
verify: Filter candidates routed to auto-close and read their band.
Pass when every auto-close candidate sits in the low band.

steps.title: Sample the top and bottom decile against specialist judgement
sop: Review the top and bottom decile candidates against the underlying claim facts.
Record agreement or disagreement with the score for each sampled candidate.
Escalate the batch to recalibration where disagreement exceeds the tolerance.
Done when the decile review is recorded with an agreement rate.
verify: Read the recorded agreement rate against the published tolerance.
Pass when the agreement rate meets tolerance or the batch is held for recalibration.

steps.title: Release the scored batch with model version stamped
sop: Stamp the model version and run timestamp on the scoring batch record.
Release the batch to the triage worklist in the payment/subrogation system.
Reconcile released candidate count to the trigger-run candidate count.
Done when the stamped batch is released and the counts reconcile.
verify: Open the released batch record and check version, timestamp and counts.
Pass when all three are present and the counts reconcile.

generic.Defined scope/population: The coverage parts under which loss payment was made on this claim and the endorsements in force.
generic.In-scope period: The policy period in force on the date of loss, including mid-term endorsements.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Coverage part, transfer-of-rights confirmation, waiver check and deductible amount are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Each paid coverage part on the claim has a matching coverage verification conclusion.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Date-of-loss policy form and endorsements attached with retrieval date and version reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Coverage parts with no recovery right are logged with the clause or endorsement that bars it.
generic.Test population: All coverage parts under which indemnity was paid on the claim.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero recovery files proceed where a waiver of subrogation endorsement is present.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous or barred coverage routes to the specialist and Legal Counsel before pursuit continues.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Verified when the transfer-of-rights clause, waiver check and anti-subrogation check are all recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Coverage verification note on the recovery file with policy documents in the claim file repository.

steps.title: Identify the coverage parts under which the loss was paid
sop: Read the payment ledger in the Claims management platform for each coverage part paid.
List the coverage parts and the indemnity amount paid under each.
Record the list on the coverage verification note.
Done when every paid coverage part is listed with its indemnity amount.
verify: Compare the listed coverage parts to the payment ledger.
Pass when the list covers every coverage part with a payment on the claim.

steps.title: Retrieve the date-of-loss policy form and endorsements
sop: Pull the policy form and all endorsements in force on the date of loss.
Attach them to the recovery file in the claim file repository.
Record the form number, edition date and retrieval date on the note.
Done when the date-of-loss form and endorsements are attached to the file.
verify: Check the attached form effective dates span the date of loss.
Pass when the date of loss falls inside the attached form period.

steps.title: Confirm the transfer-of-rights clause covers the coverage part paid
sop: Locate the transfer-of-rights or subrogation clause in the attached policy form.
Confirm it applies to each coverage part under which indemnity was paid.
Quote the clause reference on the coverage verification note.
Done when the clause reference is recorded for every paid coverage part.
verify: Check each listed coverage part for a quoted clause reference.
Pass when no paid coverage part lacks a clause reference.

steps.title: Check for a waiver of subrogation endorsement or contractual waiver
sop: Scan the endorsement schedule for any waiver of subrogation wording.
Check contracts on file such as leases or service agreements for a contractual waiver.
Record the waiver finding and, where present, halt the recovery pursuit.
Done when the waiver check outcome is recorded on the recovery file.
verify: Confirm files with a waiver finding show a halted pursuit status.
Pass when no file with a waiver present remains in active pursuit.

steps.title: Confirm no anti-subrogation bar applies
sop: Check whether the same insurer covers both the insured and the adverse party.
Check for insured-versus-additional-insured status on the same policy.
Record the anti-subrogation conclusion with the parties compared.
Done when the anti-subrogation conclusion is recorded on the file.
verify: Compare the adverse carrier name against the insurer on the underlying policy.
Pass when the comparison is recorded and any match halts the pursuit.

steps.title: Record the deductible and coinsurance in the recoverable base
sop: Read the deductible applied and any coinsurance share from the claim payment record.
Record both on the coverage verification note so the recoverable includes the insured share.
Confirm the figures match the claim payment record exactly.
Done when deductible and coinsurance are recorded and matched to the payment record.
verify: Compare the recorded deductible against the claim payment record.
Pass when the recorded figure equals the deductible applied on the claim.

generic.Defined scope/population: The legal basis establishing the right of recovery on this single recovery file.
generic.In-scope period: Validated at file opening and refreshed before the demand is served.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Recovery basis classification, supporting clause or statute citation and notice deadline are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Each recovery basis claimed on the file traces to one attached clause, statute or agreement.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Clause extract, statute citation or indemnity agreement attached with the date it was retrieved.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Ambiguous or equitable bases are logged and escalated to Legal Counsel with the question posed.
generic.Test population: Every recovery basis asserted on this file, including alternative bases held in reserve.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero files advance with the recovery basis field blank or unsupported by a citation.
generic.Exception handling path: Unsupported or ambiguous bases hold the file until Legal Counsel records an opinion.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Validated when the basis is classified, cited and confirmed free of any release by the insured.
generic.Evidence location: Recovery basis field on the file with supporting documents in the claim file repository.

steps.title: Classify the recovery basis on the recovery file
sop: Select contractual subrogation, equitable subrogation, statutory lien or contractual indemnity.
Record the classification in the recovery basis field in the payment/subrogation system.
Note any alternative basis available if the primary basis fails.
Done when the recovery basis field is populated with a classification.
verify: Check the recovery basis field for a blank or default value.
Pass when the field holds one of the four recognised classifications.

steps.title: Attach the clause, statute or indemnity agreement establishing the right
sop: Retrieve the policy clause, statute text or signed indemnity agreement.
Attach it to the recovery file in the claim file repository and cite the reference.
Confirm the cited wording actually supports the classification chosen.
Done when a supporting document is attached and cited against the classification.
verify: Read the attached wording against the recorded classification.
Pass when the attached wording supports the classification recorded.

steps.title: Confirm the insured has not released the tortfeasor
sop: Search the claim file for any release, settlement or waiver signed by the insured.
Ask the insured to confirm no separate settlement has been reached with the third party.
Record the confirmation and any release found on the recovery file.
Done when the release check outcome is recorded on the file.
verify: Check the file for a recorded release check outcome before demand.
Pass when the outcome is recorded and any release found halts the pursuit.

steps.title: Record statutory filing or notice deadlines
sop: For statutory liens, identify the filing or notice deadline the statute imposes.
Enter the deadline as a diary date in the payment/subrogation system.
Note the statute section that sets the deadline alongside the diary entry.
Done when every statutory deadline is diarised with its statute reference.
verify: Check statutory-lien files for a diarised notice deadline.
Pass when every statutory-lien file holds a diarised deadline with a citation.

steps.title: Escalate equitable or ambiguous bases to Legal Counsel
sop: Identify files where the basis is equitable or the clause wording is ambiguous.
Raise the question to Legal Counsel with the clause extract and the loss facts.
Record the counsel opinion and the resulting basis conclusion on the file.
Done when every escalated file holds a recorded counsel opinion.
verify: List escalated files and check each for a recorded opinion.
Pass when no escalated file remains without a counsel opinion.

steps.title: Confirm the validated basis on the claim record
sop: Post the validated recovery basis to the parent claim in the Claims management platform.
Confirm the basis, citation and any deadline are all visible on the claim.
Set the file status to basis validated so the demand workflow can proceed.
Done when the claim shows a validated recovery basis with citation.
verify: Open the parent claim and read the recovery basis and citation.
Pass when both appear on the claim and the status reads basis validated.

generic.Defined scope/population: Inbound adjuster subrogation referrals received into the recovery unit queue awaiting acknowledgement.
generic.In-scope period: From referral receipt timestamp to acknowledgement, measured against the unit service standard.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Referral received date and time, referral source and recovery reference number are all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Acknowledgements sent equal referrals received into the recovery queue for the day.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Acknowledgement logged as a claim activity note with send timestamp and sender name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Referrals that cannot be acknowledged for missing claim links are logged with the blocking reason.
generic.Test population: All referrals received into the recovery unit queue during the reporting day.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero referrals unacknowledged beyond the unit referral SLA.
generic.Exception handling path: Short-fuse referrals under 90 days statute runway escalate to same-day specialist attention.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Acknowledged when the referring adjuster holds the recovery reference and the activity note exists.
generic.Evidence location: Acknowledgement activity note on the claim in the Claims management platform.

steps.title: Stamp the referral received date and time on the recovery record
sop: Open the inbound referral in the payment/subrogation system queue.
Stamp the received date and time on the recovery record to start the acknowledgement clock.
Confirm the referral links to the correct parent claim number.
Done when the received timestamp is stamped and the claim link is confirmed.
verify: Compare the stamped timestamp against the queue arrival time.
Pass when the stamped time matches queue arrival and the claim link resolves.

steps.title: Record the referral source for detection reporting
sop: Select the source of auto-trigger, adjuster, SIU or intercompany on the referral record.
Where the source is unclear, ask the referring adjuster before recording it.
Save the source so detection metrics can attribute the referral correctly.
Done when the referral source is recorded on the referral record.
verify: Check the referral source field for a blank or default value.
Pass when the field holds one of the four recognised sources.

steps.title: Generate and send the acknowledgement to the referring adjuster
sop: Generate the recovery reference number in the payment/subrogation system.
Send the acknowledgement to the referring adjuster quoting that reference.
Include the assigned queue and the expected next contact date.
Done when the acknowledgement is sent with the recovery reference quoted.
verify: Open the sent acknowledgement and check the recovery reference appears.
Pass when the reference is present and the send timestamp is inside the SLA.

steps.title: Flag short-fuse referrals for same-day attention
sop: Read the statute expiry on the referred claim from the Claims management platform.
Flag any referral with under 90 days runway as short fuse on the recovery record.
Route flagged referrals to a specialist for same-day review.
Done when every short-fuse referral carries the flag and a same-day routing.
verify: Filter the day's referrals for statute runway under 90 days.
Pass when every filtered referral shows the short-fuse flag.

steps.title: Confirm the referring adjuster received the acknowledgement
sop: Open the acknowledgement on the claim and confirm the recovery reference is usable.
Raise any correction needed on claim number, loss facts or adverse party detail.
Confirm receipt back to the recovery unit on the claim activity thread.
Done when the adjuster has confirmed receipt or raised a correction.
verify: Check the activity thread for an adjuster receipt confirmation.
Pass when a confirmation or a correction request is recorded on the claim.

steps.title: Log the acknowledgement as a claim activity for cycle-time reporting
sop: Write the acknowledgement as a claim activity note in the Claims management platform.
Include the referral received time, acknowledgement time and the recovery reference.
Confirm the note is of the activity type cycle-time reporting reads.
Done when the acknowledgement activity note exists on the claim.
verify: Query the day's referrals for a matching acknowledgement activity note.
Pass when every referral holds an acknowledgement note inside the SLA.

generic.Defined scope/population: All exhibits needed to evidence liability, damages and payment on this recovery file.
generic.In-scope period: Documents covering the loss event through the latest payment made on the underlying claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every exhibit carries an index number, document type, date and source on the package index.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exhibit count in the package equals the entries on the document index with no gaps.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Indexed package stored with compile date, compiler name and version number on the recovery file.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing exhibits are listed on the index as outstanding with an owner and a chase date.
generic.Test population: Every exhibit in the assembled package plus the outstanding-item list.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero packages released externally containing unredacted personal or medical data.
generic.Exception handling path: Outstanding exhibits hold the demand draft until obtained or formally waived by the specialist.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Package accepted when payment proof, damages proof and liability proof are each indexed and redacted.
generic.Evidence location: Indexed evidence package on the recovery file in the claim file repository.

steps.title: Print the payment ledger from the claims platform
sop: Open the claim payment ledger in the Claims management platform.
Print indemnity paid, expense paid and the deductible applied as at today.
Attach the ledger print to the evidence package with the as-at date shown.
Done when the payment ledger print is attached with an as-at date.
verify: Compare the ledger print totals to the claim payment record.
Pass when the printed totals equal the live claim payment totals.

steps.title: Attach repair estimate, invoices and total-loss valuation
sop: Retrieve the repair estimate or appraisal and all supporting invoices.
Add the total-loss valuation report where the claim settled as a total loss.
Attach each document to the package and record its exhibit number.
Done when every damages document is attached and numbered.
verify: Reconcile invoice totals against the indemnity paid on the ledger print.
Pass when invoice totals support the indemnity paid or the difference is explained.

steps.title: Add the police report, photographs and statement transcripts
sop: Retrieve the police or incident report from the claim file repository.
Add scene photographs and any recorded statement transcripts on file.
Number each as an exhibit and record its date and source on the index.
Done when all liability exhibits are attached and indexed.
verify: Check each liability exhibit on the index resolves to an attached document.
Pass when every indexed liability exhibit opens from the package.

steps.title: Add proof of payment evidencing the insurer paid the loss
sop: Obtain the draft copy or EFT confirmation for each indemnity payment made.
Attach the proof of payment to the package as a numbered exhibit.
Confirm payee, amount and payment date are legible on the document.
Done when proof of payment is attached for every indemnity payment claimed.
verify: Match each proof of payment to a ledger payment line.
Pass when every claimed payment line holds a matching proof of payment.

steps.title: Redact medical and personal data not required for recovery
sop: Review every exhibit for medical detail, identifiers and unrelated personal data.
Redact the material not required to prove liability, damages or payment.
Record the redaction pass on the package with reviewer name and date.
Done when the redaction pass is complete and recorded on the package.
verify: Spot-check exhibits containing personal data for applied redactions.
Pass when no sampled exhibit shows unredacted medical or personal data.

steps.title: Build the document index and attach the package to the recovery file
sop: Build the index listing each exhibit number, type, date and source.
List outstanding exhibits with an owner and a chase date at the end of the index.
Attach the indexed package to the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.
Done when the indexed package is attached to the recovery file.
verify: Compare the index entry count to the attached exhibit count.
Pass when the counts agree and every outstanding item names an owner and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Newly opened recovery files awaiting assignment to a named specialist owner.
generic.In-scope period: Assignment completed within one business day of the recovery file being opened.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Assigned specialist name, assignment date, authority level and jurisdiction match are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assigned file count equals the recovery files opened in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assignment record stamped with assignor name, assignee name and assignment timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Files that cannot be assigned for capacity or licensing reasons are logged with the blocker.
generic.Test population: All recovery files opened in the period plus any file reassigned during it.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero open recovery files remain assigned only to a team queue.
generic.Exception handling path: Unassignable files escalate to the unit manager for capacity or licensing resolution.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assigned when the named specialist is licensed for the venue and inside the authority band.
generic.Evidence location: Assignment field and diary entry on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Read the file jurisdiction and line of business
sop: Open the newly created recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.
Read the loss jurisdiction, line of business and expected recoverable.
Record these as the assignment criteria on the file.
Done when jurisdiction, line of business and expected recoverable are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded values against the parent claim record.
Pass when the recorded values match the parent claim.

steps.title: Match the file to a specialist licensed in the loss jurisdiction
sop: Filter the specialist roster to those licensed and experienced in that jurisdiction and line.
Exclude specialists at or above their caseload cap.
Shortlist the candidate assignees on the assignment note.
Done when a shortlist of licensed available specialists exists on the file.
verify: Check each shortlisted specialist against the licensing register for that jurisdiction.
Pass when every shortlisted specialist is licensed for the loss jurisdiction.

steps.title: Check the assignee authority level covers the expected recoverable
sop: Compare the expected recoverable against each shortlisted specialist authority limit.
Remove candidates whose authority is below the expected recoverable.
Record the authority check result on the assignment note.
Done when the authority check is recorded for the chosen assignee.
verify: Compare the chosen assignee authority limit to the expected recoverable.
Pass when the authority limit meets or exceeds the expected recoverable.

steps.title: Route complex, large-loss or litigated files to a senior specialist
sop: Identify files flagged complex liability, large loss or already in litigation.
Assign those files to a senior specialist rather than the standard queue.
Record the complexity reason driving the senior routing.
Done when every complex file is routed to a senior specialist with a reason.
verify: Filter files flagged complex and read the assignee seniority.
Pass when every complex file is assigned to a senior specialist.

steps.title: Confirm no conflict with the underlying claim payment handler
sop: Compare the proposed assignee against the handler who approved the claim payment.
Reassign where the same person handled the underlying payment decision.
Record the conflict check outcome on the assignment note.
Done when the conflict check outcome is recorded for the chosen assignee.
verify: Compare assignee name against the claim payment approver name.
Pass when the two names differ on every assigned file.

steps.title: Set the named owner and confirm the file reaches the assignee diary
sop: Set the named specialist as file owner in the payment/subrogation system.
Notify the assignee and stamp the assignment date on the file.
Confirm the file appears on the assignee diary within one business day.
Done when the file shows a named owner and appears on the assignee diary.
verify: Query open recovery files for a team queue owner rather than a named owner.
Pass when the query returns zero files owned only by a queue.

generic.Defined scope/population: The evidence and document lines required to support demand on this recovery file's loss type.
generic.In-scope period: Checklist built at file opening and maintained through to the demand target date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every checklist line carries a document name, an owner and a due date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Checklist line count matches the template lines plus any jurisdiction-specific additions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Checklist stored on the file with template name, template version and build date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lines marked not applicable carry a stated reason rather than being deleted from the checklist.
generic.Test population: All checklist lines on the recovery file including not-applicable lines.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero checklist lines without an assigned owner and a due date.
generic.Exception handling path: Third-party sourced items get an extended lead time and a chase diary rather than a standard date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when payment, damages, liability and coverage proof lines are each present and owned.
generic.Evidence location: Evidence checklist attached to the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Select the checklist template matching the loss type
sop: Read the loss type from the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.
Select the template for auto physical damage, property, liability or product loss.
Record the template name and version on the checklist header.
Done when the correct template is applied and its version recorded.
verify: Compare the applied template against the recorded loss type.
Pass when the template matches the loss type on the file.

steps.title: Add mandatory proof lines for payment, damages, liability and coverage
sop: Confirm the template carries a proof-of-payment line and a damages proof line.
Confirm liability proof and policy or coverage proof lines are present.
Add any mandatory line the template omits for this loss.
Done when all four mandatory proof categories appear on the checklist.
verify: Check the checklist for each of the four mandatory proof categories.
Pass when all four categories are present on the checklist.

steps.title: Add jurisdiction-specific document lines
sop: Read the loss jurisdiction and identify statutory prerequisites for demand.
Add lines for no-fault forms, lien notices or statutory demand documents required.
Cite the statute or rule that makes each addition necessary.
Done when every jurisdiction-specific requirement appears as a checklist line.
verify: Compare the added lines against the venue research note for the file.
Pass when every statutory prerequisite in the research note appears on the checklist.

steps.title: Set diary dates for each outstanding item ahead of the demand target
sop: Read the demand target date from the recovery file diary.
Set each checklist line due date to fall before the demand target date.
Load the due dates into the file diary in the payment/subrogation system.
Done when every open line holds a due date ahead of the demand target.
verify: Compare each line due date against the demand target date.
Pass when no open line is due on or after the demand target date.

steps.title: Mark third-party sourced items with extended lead time
sop: Identify items obtainable only from third parties such as police or medical records.
Mark each as third-party sourced and apply the published lead time.
Set an early chase diary so the lead time is protected.
Done when third-party items are marked with lead time and a chase diary.
verify: Filter checklist lines marked third-party sourced for a chase diary.
Pass when every third-party item holds a chase diary date.

steps.title: Assign an owner to every checklist line and publish the checklist
sop: Assign a named owner to each open checklist line.
Record a not-applicable reason on any line that does not apply to this loss.
Attach the completed checklist to the recovery file and the document repository.
Done when every line holds an owner or a not-applicable reason and the checklist is attached.
verify: Scan the checklist for lines with no owner and no not-applicable reason.
Pass when the scan returns zero such lines.

generic.Defined scope/population: All indemnity, deductible and recoverable expense components of the loss on this recovery file.
generic.In-scope period: Payments made on the underlying claim to the calculation as-of date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Indemnity paid, deductible, recoverable expense, salvage credit and as-of date are all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Gross recoverable equals indemnity plus deductible plus expense less salvage already realised.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calculation note stored with the as-of date, preparer name and the ledger extract relied on.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Expense components excluded as non-recoverable are listed with the rule that excludes them.
generic.Test population: Every payment line on the claim payment ledger to the as-of date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero gross recoverable figures include salvage proceeds already credited to the claim.
generic.Exception handling path: Payments made after the as-of date trigger a refresh before the demand is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when every component ties to a ledger line and the as-of date is stated.
generic.Evidence location: Gross recoverable calculation note on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Pull total indemnity paid from the claim payment ledger
sop: Open the claim payment ledger in the Claims management platform.
Sum indemnity paid to date and record it as the calculation base.
Record the ledger extract reference and the as-of date.
Done when the indemnity base is recorded with a ledger reference and as-of date.
verify: Re-sum the ledger indemnity lines independently.
Pass when the independent sum equals the recorded indemnity base.

steps.title: Add the insured deductible to the recoverable base
sop: Read the deductible applied on the claim for the coverage part paid.
Add it to the indemnity base so the demand pursues the full loss.
Record the deductible amount separately on the calculation note.
Done when the deductible is added and shown as a separate line.
verify: Compare the deductible on the note to the deductible applied on the claim.
Pass when the two figures are identical.

steps.title: Add recoverable allocated loss adjustment expense where permitted
sop: Identify allocated loss adjustment expense paid on the claim.
Confirm the jurisdiction or contract permits recovery of that expense.
Add only permitted expense and note the rule allowing it.
Done when permitted expense is added with the permitting rule cited.
verify: Check each expense line added against the cited permitting rule.
Pass when every added expense line cites a permitting rule.

steps.title: Subtract salvage proceeds already realised
sop: Query salvage proceeds credited against the claim in the ERP general ledger.
Subtract realised salvage from the recoverable so it is not demanded twice.
Record the salvage credit reference on the calculation note.
Done when realised salvage is subtracted and referenced.
verify: Compare the salvage credit on the note against the ledger salvage postings.
Pass when the subtracted amount equals the ledger salvage credited.

steps.title: Record the gross recoverable with an as-of date on the recovery file
sop: Total the components into the gross recoverable figure.
Write the figure and the as-of date to the recovery file in the subrogation system.
Attach the calculation note showing each component line.
Done when the gross recoverable and as-of date are on the recovery file.
verify: Re-add the component lines on the calculation note.
Pass when the components total the recorded gross recoverable exactly.

steps.title: Set a diary to refresh the figure before demand issue
sop: Set a diary date ahead of the demand target to refresh the calculation.
Note that any supplemental payment after the as-of date triggers recalculation.
Confirm the diary is loaded in the payment/subrogation system.
Done when the refresh diary is set on the recovery file.
verify: Check the recovery file diary for a refresh entry before the demand target.
Pass when a refresh diary entry exists ahead of the demand target date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims whose incurred plus expected recovery approaches or exceeds the treaty attachment point.
generic.In-scope period: The loss occurrence year governing the treaty terms applied to the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Attachment point, incurred figure, exposure type and reinsurance notification reference are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims above the attachment point equal the ceded-loss notification flags set for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notification evidence retained with send date, recipient and the reinsurance reference returned.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims near but under the attachment point are logged for monitoring with a review date.
generic.Test population: All claims reviewed against the treaty attachment point in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero claims above the attachment point without a ceded-loss flag and reinsurance reference.
generic.Exception handling path: Facultative placements notify within 72 hours of the threshold being crossed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Flagged when exposure type is identified and the notification deadline is met and evidenced.
generic.Evidence location: Ceded-loss flag on the claim record with the reference on the recovery file.

steps.title: Compare incurred plus expected recovery to the treaty attachment point
sop: Read incurred to date on the claim in the Claims management platform.
Add the expected recovery from the recovery file to form the comparison figure.
Compare against the treaty attachment point for the loss occurrence year.
Done when the comparison result is recorded on the claim.
verify: Recompute the comparison figure from incurred and expected recovery.
Pass when the recomputed figure matches the recorded comparison.

steps.title: Identify whether the exposure is treaty or facultative
sop: Look up the reinsurance placement attaching to the policy and occurrence year.
Classify the exposure as treaty or facultative on the claim record.
Record the placement reference alongside the classification.
Done when the exposure classification and placement reference are recorded.
verify: Check the classification against the placement register for the occurrence year.
Pass when the recorded classification matches the placement register.

steps.title: Apply the notification deadline for the exposure type
sop: Read the contractual notification deadline for the identified placement.
Apply 72 hours for facultative placements crossing the threshold.
Diary the deadline on the claim so it cannot be missed.
Done when the notification deadline is diarised on the claim.
verify: Compare the diarised deadline against the contract notification term.
Pass when the diarised date is on or before the contractual deadline.

steps.title: Set the ceded-loss notification flag on the claim
sop: Set the ceded-loss notification flag on the claim in the Claims management platform.
Confirm the flag drives recovery proceeds to be shared with reinsurance.
Record the flag date and the setter name.
Done when the ceded-loss flag is set and dated on the claim.
verify: Filter claims above the attachment point for a ceded-loss flag.
Pass when every claim above the attachment point carries the flag.

steps.title: Issue the notification and capture the reinsurance reference
sop: Issue the ceded-loss notification to the reinsurer or broker for the placement.
Capture the reference the reinsurer returns on the recovery file.
Retain the transmission confirmation against the claim.
Done when the reinsurance reference and transmission evidence are on file.
verify: Check flagged claims for a recorded reinsurance reference.
Pass when every flagged claim holds a reference and transmission evidence.

steps.title: Link the reference to the recovery file for later offset reconciliation
sop: Write the reinsurance reference to the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.
Note the expected ceded share so allocation can reconcile at recovery.
Set a diary to reconcile the ceded share when recovery proceeds arrive.
Done when the recovery file holds the reference and expected ceded share.
verify: Open the recovery file and read the reinsurance reference and ceded share.
Pass when both are present and a reconciliation diary exists.

generic.Defined scope/population: Validated referrals accepted into the recovery unit and awaiting a recovery file to be created.
generic.In-scope period: File opened the same day the referral validation outcome is recorded as accepted.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss date, jurisdiction, recovery basis, adverse party, recovery type and expected recoverable are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recovery files opened equals validated referrals accepted for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: File creation record stamped with open date, opener name and the source referral reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Referrals not opened are logged with the blocking reason and a resolution owner.
generic.Test population: All recovery files opened in the period and all accepted referrals awaiting opening.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero duplicate open recovery files for the same claim number and adverse party.
generic.Exception handling path: Suspected duplicates hold at draft until the existing file is reviewed and merged or dismissed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Opened when the file links to the parent claim and the recovery receivable is established.
generic.Evidence location: Recovery file record linked to the parent claim in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Create the recovery record linked to the parent claim
sop: Create a recovery record in the payment/subrogation system from the accepted referral.
Link it to the parent claim number so payments and recoveries reconcile to one claim.
Stamp the open date, opener name and source referral reference.
Done when the recovery record exists and resolves to the parent claim.
verify: Open the parent claim and check the recovery file appears against it.
Pass when the recovery file is visible on the parent claim.

steps.title: Populate loss, jurisdiction and adverse party fields at open
sop: Copy loss date, jurisdiction and adverse party from the validated referral.
Populate the recovery basis and the expected recoverable figure.
Leave no mandatory field blank at the point of opening.
Done when all mandatory open fields are populated on the recovery file.
verify: Scan the new file for blank mandatory fields.
Pass when no mandatory field is blank at open.

steps.title: Set the recovery type to drive the correct workflow
sop: Select subrogation, deductible, salvage or intercompany arbitration as the recovery type.
Confirm the type selected drives the intended downstream workflow.
Record the reason where more than one type could apply.
Done when the recovery type is set and the workflow matches it.
verify: Compare the workflow steps presented against the selected recovery type.
Pass when the presented workflow matches the recorded recovery type.

steps.title: Check no duplicate recovery file exists for the claim and adverse party
sop: Search open recovery files for the same claim number and adverse party.
Hold the new file at draft where a match is found and review the existing file.
Record the duplicate check outcome on the new recovery file.
Done when the duplicate check outcome is recorded before the file activates.
verify: Re-run the duplicate search after the file activates.
Pass when the search returns exactly one open file for that claim and adverse party.

steps.title: Establish the recovery receivable for ageing visibility
sop: Raise the recovery receivable at the expected recoverable figure.
Confirm the balance appears in the recovery ageing report from day one.
Record the receivable reference on the recovery file.
Done when the receivable exists and appears on the ageing report.
verify: Search the ageing report for the new receivable balance.
Pass when the new file appears on the ageing report with the expected recoverable.

steps.title: Post the recovery file reference back to the claim record
sop: Write the recovery file reference onto the claim in the Claims management platform.
Confirm the adjuster view shows an active recovery file on the claim.
Notify the referring adjuster that the file is open.
Done when the claim record shows the active recovery file reference.
verify: Open the claim and read the recovery file reference.
Pass when the reference is present and resolves to the opened recovery file.

generic.Defined scope/population: Police, fire and incident reports required by the evidence checklist on this recovery file.
generic.In-scope period: From checklist creation to the demand target date, with chases at the stated turnaround.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Issuing authority, report number, request date, fee paid and follow-up diary are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reports requested equals the report lines marked required on the evidence checklist.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Request submission and any receipt retained on the recovery file with the request date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reports the authority will not release are logged with the refusal reason and an alternative source.
generic.Test population: All report lines on the evidence checklist for this recovery file.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero required report lines without a logged request and a follow-up diary date.
generic.Exception handling path: Lapsed turnaround triggers a chase, then escalation to the authority records supervisor.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Requested when authority, request date and diary are logged and any fee or release form is submitted.
generic.Evidence location: Report request log on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.
