steps.title: Identify the issuing authority and report number from the loss notice
sop: Read the loss notice and adjuster notes for the responding authority and report number.
Confirm the jurisdiction of the responding agency where several could apply.
Record the authority name and report number on the request log.
Done when authority and report number are recorded before ordering.
verify: Compare the recorded authority against the loss location.
Pass when the authority has jurisdiction over the loss location.

steps.title: Submit the request with loss details and any fee or release form
sop: Complete the authority request form with date of loss, location and parties.
Attach the required release form and pay any prescribed fee.
Submit the request and retain the submission confirmation.
Done when the request is submitted with confirmation retained.
verify: Check the submission confirmation shows the loss date and report number.
Pass when the confirmation carries both and any fee receipt is attached.

steps.title: Log the request against the recovery file
sop: Record the request date, authority and report number on the recovery file log.
Link the request to the matching evidence checklist line.
Set the checklist line status to requested.
Done when the request is logged and linked to the checklist line.
verify: Compare logged requests to required report lines on the checklist.
Pass when every required report line has a matching logged request.

steps.title: Set a follow-up diary at the stated turnaround
sop: Read the authority stated turnaround time for report release.
Set a diary in the payment/subrogation system at that turnaround date.
Chase the authority on lapse and record each chase on the request log.
Done when a follow-up diary exists and chases are recorded on lapse.
verify: Check open requests past turnaround for a recorded chase.
Pass when every overdue request holds at least one recorded chase.

steps.title: Review the received report for the adverse party and any citation
sop: Read the received report for the named adverse party and any citation issued.
Record the cited party and fault statement on the adverse party record.
Raise a correction request to the authority where the report is incomplete.
Done when the report content is reviewed and the findings recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded findings against the report text.
Pass when the recorded party and citation match the report.

steps.title: Index the report into the evidence package and update the checklist
sop: File the report into the claim file repository under the recovery file.
Add it to the evidence package index with an exhibit number.
Update the evidence checklist line status to received with the receipt date.
Done when the report is indexed and the checklist line reads received.
verify: Open the evidence index and confirm the report exhibit resolves.
Pass when the exhibit opens and the checklist line status reads received.

generic.Defined scope/population: All physical and digital evidence relevant to the recovery matter on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From identification of potential recovery litigation until the hold is formally released.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Hold notice date, custodian list, acknowledgements and chain-of-custody entries are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Custodian acknowledgements received equal custodians served with the litigation hold notice.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Hold notice retained with issue timestamp and each acknowledgement dated by custodian.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Custodians who do not acknowledge are logged and escalated with a chase record.
generic.Test population: All custodians served and all physical and digital items placed under hold.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero held physical items released to salvage disposal while the hold remains open.
generic.Exception handling path: Items already disposed of are logged as spoliation risk and escalated to Legal Counsel.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Protected when the hold is issued within 24 hours and every item shows a custody entry.
generic.Evidence location: Litigation hold notice and custody log on the recovery file in the claim file repository.

steps.title: Issue the litigation hold notice within 24 hours
sop: Identify the custodians holding relevant physical or digital evidence.
Issue the litigation hold notice naming the matter and the material to preserve.
Record the issue timestamp and the served custodian list on the recovery file.
Done when the hold notice is issued and the custodian list is recorded.
verify: Compare the hold issue timestamp against the litigation trigger date.
Pass when the notice was issued within 24 hours of the trigger.

steps.title: Track custodian acknowledgements to completion
sop: Record each custodian acknowledgement with the date received.
Chase non-responding custodians and log each chase attempt.
Escalate persistent non-response to Legal Counsel.
Done when every served custodian has acknowledged or been escalated.
verify: Compare acknowledgements received to custodians served.
Pass when every custodian shows an acknowledgement or an escalation record.

steps.title: Place a do-not-destroy hold on the damaged item before salvage
sop: Set the do-not-destroy flag on the vehicle, product or component in the claim record.
Notify the salvage vendor in writing that disposal is blocked.
Record the hold and the vendor notification on the recovery file.
Done when the do-not-destroy hold is set and the vendor is notified.
verify: Check the salvage disposal status on held items.
Pass when no held item shows a disposal or sale status.

steps.title: Record chain of custody for each physical item
sop: Log the current holder, storage location and transfer dates for each item.
Capture a signature from the receiving custodian on every transfer.
Store the custody log against the recovery file in the document repository.
Done when each held item carries a complete custody log entry.
verify: Read the custody log for gaps between transfers.
Pass when the log shows an unbroken custodian sequence for each item.

steps.title: Preserve digital evidence ahead of retention purges
sop: Identify telematics, CCTV, photographs and system logs relevant to the loss.
Export and store copies in the claim file repository before routine purge dates.
Record the export date, source system and the retention date avoided.
Done when each digital source is exported and stored with its export record.
verify: Compare the export dates against the source system retention purge dates.
Pass when every export predates its source purge date.

steps.title: Notify the adverse party and offer joint inspection
sop: Notify the adverse party or carrier of the preserved evidence in writing.
Offer a joint inspection before any destructive testing takes place.
Retain the notification and any response on the recovery file.
Done when the notification is sent and retained with any reply.
verify: Check for a notification on file dated before any destructive testing.
Pass when the notification predates any destructive testing carried out.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every limitation period and notice deadline bearing on the recovery rights for this file.
generic.In-scope period: From file opening through to demand, arbitration or suit filing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Statute expiry date, cause of action, jurisdiction and diary reminder dates are all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Diary reminders set equal the four escalation points required on every open file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Statute determination note stored with the research source and the date it was determined.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Files with competing periods across parties log each period separately with its party named.
generic.Test population: All open recovery files and their recorded statute expiry dates.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero open files with a past statute date and no closure or suit-filed disposition.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous limitation periods escalate to Legal Counsel before the date is locked on the file.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Set when the shortest applicable period is locked and all four reminders are diarised.
generic.Evidence location: Statute expiry field and diary entries on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Determine the controlling limitation period for the venue
sop: Identify the venue and the cause of action for the recovery claim.
Determine the limitation period for property damage, injury, contract or product as applicable.
Record the period, the statute citation and the determination date on the file.
Done when the limitation period is recorded with a statute citation.
verify: Check the recorded period against the cited statute.
Pass when the recorded period matches the cited statutory term.

steps.title: Enter the statute expiry as a locked field on the recovery file
sop: Calculate the expiry date from the accrual date and the limitation period.
Enter it in the locked statute expiry field in the payment/subrogation system.
Confirm the field blocks silent closure of the file.
Done when the locked statute expiry field holds a calculated date.
verify: Attempt a test closure on the file without a disposition.
Pass when the system blocks closure while the statute date is unresolved.

steps.title: Set escalating diary reminders before expiry
sop: Set diary reminders at 180, 90, 30 and 10 days before the statute expiry.
Assign each reminder to the file owner in the payment/subrogation system.
Confirm all four reminders appear on the owner diary.
Done when all four reminders are loaded against the file owner.
verify: Count the diary reminders on the file against the four required points.
Pass when all four reminders exist with the correct offsets.

steps.title: Apply the shortest period where several parties or venues apply
sop: List each potentially liable party and the venue applying to that party.
Record the limitation period for each and identify the shortest.
Drive the file diary from the shortest applicable period.
Done when each party period is recorded and the shortest drives the diary.
verify: Compare the file diary date against the shortest recorded period.
Pass when the diary is driven by the shortest recorded period.

steps.title: Diary shorter contractual or statutory notice deadlines separately
sop: Check for governmental entity notice or no-fault filing deadlines shorter than the statute.
Record each such deadline with its source on the recovery file.
Set a separate diary for each notice deadline.
Done when every shorter notice deadline is recorded and separately diarised.
verify: Check for notice deadlines recorded without a matching diary entry.
Pass when every recorded notice deadline holds its own diary entry.

steps.title: Mirror the statute date onto the claim record
sop: Write the statute expiry date to the claim in the Claims management platform.
Confirm the adjuster view shows the recovery statute date on the claim.
Set the recovery file status so ageing reporting can prioritise short-fuse files.
Done when the statute date is visible on the parent claim record.
verify: Open the parent claim and read the statute expiry date.
Pass when the claim date matches the locked date on the recovery file.

generic.Defined scope/population: Inbound subrogation referrals awaiting a completeness check against the intake standard.
generic.In-scope period: Validation completed on the day of referral receipt into the recovery unit.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Payment status, adverse party detail, loss facts and liability rationale are each present.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Validation outcomes recorded equal referrals received in the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation outcome stored with validator name, date and the missing-item list where returned.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Returned referrals are logged with the named missing items and the adjuster they returned to.
generic.Test population: All referrals received into the recovery unit during the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero recovery files opened from a referral still marked incomplete.
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete referrals return to the referring adjuster with a named missing-item list.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Validated when payment, adverse party, loss facts and final coverage decision are all confirmed.
generic.Evidence location: Validation outcome field on the referral record in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Confirm the claim is paid or reserved with an actual outlay
sop: Read the claim payment and reserve position in the Claims management platform.
Confirm an indemnity payment or a firm reserve exists to recover against.
Record the outlay figure on the referral validation record.
Done when the outlay figure is recorded on the referral.
verify: Compare the recorded outlay against the claim payment ledger.
Pass when the recorded outlay matches the ledger position.

steps.title: Check adverse party details and liability rationale are present
sop: Read the referral for adverse party name, contact and the liability rationale given.
Supply any detail the referral omits from the underlying claim file.
Mark each intake field as present or missing on the validation record.
Done when every intake field is marked present or missing.
verify: Scan the validation record for unmarked intake fields.
Pass when no intake field is left unmarked.

steps.title: Verify the coverage decision on the underlying claim is final
sop: Check the coverage decision status on the claim in the claims platform.
Confirm no reconsideration, appeal or reservation of rights remains open.
Record the coverage finality conclusion on the validation record.
Done when coverage finality is confirmed and recorded.
verify: Check claims with an open coverage review for an accepted validation.
Pass when no referral validates as accepted while coverage remains under review.

steps.title: Return incomplete referrals with a named missing-item list
sop: List every missing intake item by name on the validation record.
Return the referral to the referring adjuster with that list attached.
Set a diary to re-check the returned referral within the intake standard.
Done when the referral is returned with a named missing-item list.
verify: Open returned referrals and check for a named missing-item list.
Pass when every returned referral carries a specific missing-item list.

steps.title: Record the validation outcome on the referral record
sop: Set the outcome to accepted or returned in the payment/subrogation system.
Stamp the validator name and the validation date.
Attach the supporting notes to the claim file repository.
Done when every referral carries a stamped validation outcome.
verify: Query referrals in the period for a blank validation outcome.
Pass when the query returns zero referrals without an outcome.

steps.title: Trigger same-day recovery file opening on accepted referrals
sop: Release accepted referrals to the file opening queue the same day.
Confirm no referral marked incomplete reaches the opening queue.
Reconcile accepted referrals to recovery files opened at end of day.
Done when accepted referrals are released and reconciled to files opened.
verify: Compare accepted referral count to recovery files opened for the day.
Pass when the counts agree and no incomplete referral produced a file.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every party identified in the liability chain for this loss, including the insured.
generic.In-scope period: Apportionment set before the demand is drafted and refreshed on new liability evidence.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Venue rule, fault percentage per party and the evidence cited for each percentage are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assigned fault percentages across all parties total exactly 100 percent.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Apportionment note stored with the assessment date, assessor name and evidence references.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Parties assessed at zero fault are recorded with the reason rather than omitted from the note.
generic.Test population: All parties on the liability chain for this recovery file.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero demands issued at 100 percent where insured fault is assessed above zero.
generic.Exception handling path: Files barred by the modified comparative threshold route to close-out review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the venue rule is named and every percentage cites a supporting exhibit.
generic.Evidence location: Fault apportionment note on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Read the venue negligence rule from the research note
sop: Open the venue research note held on the recovery file.
Identify the rule as pure comparative, modified comparative or contributory negligence.
Record the rule and any bar threshold on the apportionment note.
Done when the venue rule and bar threshold are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded rule against the venue research note.
Pass when the recorded rule matches the research note conclusion.

steps.title: Assign a fault percentage to each identified party
sop: List every party from the liability chain including the insured.
Assign a fault percentage to each based on the assessed breach and causation.
Confirm the assigned percentages total 100 percent.
Done when every party carries a percentage and the total is 100 percent.
verify: Sum the assigned percentages across all parties.
Pass when the sum equals exactly 100 percent.

steps.title: Cite the evidence supporting each percentage assigned
sop: For each party, name the fact or exhibit that supports the percentage assigned.
Reference the exhibit number from the evidence package index.
Flag any percentage resting on inference rather than evidence.
Done when every percentage cites an exhibit or is flagged as inferred.
verify: Check each percentage on the note for a cited exhibit or an inference flag.
Pass when no percentage is left uncited and unflagged.

steps.title: Apply the venue rule to test whether recovery survives
sop: Apply the venue bar threshold to the insured fault percentage assessed.
Determine whether recovery is reduced, barred or unaffected.
Record the legal conclusion and its effect on the recoverable.
Done when the venue rule effect on recovery is recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded effect against the insured fault percentage and the bar.
Pass when the recorded effect follows correctly from the percentage and the bar.

steps.title: Reduce the demand figure by the insured fault share
sop: Apply the adverse fault percentage to the gross recoverable figure.
Record the fault-adjusted demand amount on the recovery file.
Confirm the demand draft will use the adjusted figure, not the gross.
Done when the fault-adjusted demand amount is recorded on the file.
verify: Recompute gross recoverable times the adverse fault percentage.
Pass when the recomputed figure equals the recorded demand amount.

steps.title: Flag files barred by the modified comparative threshold
sop: Identify files where insured fault meets or exceeds the venue bar.
Flag those files for close-out review in the payment/subrogation system.
Record the bar analysis so the closure reason is evidenced.
Done when every barred file carries a close-out review flag.
verify: Filter files where insured fault meets the bar and read the flag status.
Pass when every such file shows a close-out review flag.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every defense and doctrine capable of reducing or barring recovery on this file.
generic.In-scope period: Assessed before the pursue decision and refreshed when the adverse party pleads a new defense.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Defense name, legal basis, evidence relied on and the recovery haircut are recorded per defense.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total assessed haircut reconciles to the difference between gross and expected recoverable.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Defense assessment note stored with assessment date and the contract or statute references relied on.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Defenses considered and dismissed are recorded with the reason they do not apply.
generic.Test population: All defenses tested on this file, including those dismissed as inapplicable.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every identified defense carries a stated recovery impact rather than a blank assessment.
generic.Exception handling path: Defenses with unclear application escalate to Legal Counsel before the pursue decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when negligence, waiver, anti-subrogation and made-whole are each tested and recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Defense assessment note on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Test comparative or contributory negligence exposure
sop: Read the insured fault percentage from the apportionment note.
Test it against the venue bar threshold recorded in the research note.
Record the resulting reduction or bar as the negligence exposure.
Done when the negligence exposure and its recovery impact are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded exposure against the apportionment and the venue bar.
Pass when the recorded impact follows from the percentage and the bar.

steps.title: Check contracts for waiver or exculpatory clauses
sop: Retrieve leases, repair and service contracts from the claim file repository.
Read for waiver of subrogation, exculpatory or limitation of liability wording.
Record each clause found with its contract reference and effect.
Done when every contract on file has been read and the outcome recorded.
verify: List contracts on the claim and check each has a read outcome recorded.
Pass when no contract on file is left unread.

steps.title: Check the anti-subrogation rule where one insurer covers both parties
sop: Compare the insurer on the underlying policy against the adverse carrier.
Check for additional-insured status linking the parties on one policy.
Record the anti-subrogation conclusion on the defense assessment note.
Done when the anti-subrogation conclusion is recorded.
verify: Read the recorded conclusion against the insurer and adverse carrier names.
Pass when the conclusion follows from the compared insurer names.

steps.title: Assess made-whole and economic-loss doctrines
sop: Determine whether the venue applies the made-whole doctrine to this loss.
Test the economic-loss rule where the claim is product or construction related.
Record each doctrine conclusion with the citation relied on.
Done when both doctrines are tested and their conclusions recorded.
verify: Check both doctrines appear on the note with a conclusion and citation.
Pass when both are present with a citation.

steps.title: Assign a percentage haircut to each surviving defense
sop: For each defense that survives, estimate the percentage reduction to expected recovery.
State the reasoning behind each haircut on the assessment note.
Total the haircuts to a combined expected recovery impact.
Done when every surviving defense carries a percentage haircut.
verify: Recompute expected recoverable using the recorded haircuts.
Pass when the recomputed figure matches the expected recoverable on the file.

steps.title: Feed the assessment into the pursue-or-close decision
sop: Attach the defense assessment note to the recovery file in the subrogation system.
Update the expected recoverable to reflect the combined haircut.
Notify the decision owner that the assessment is complete.
Done when the assessment is attached and the expected recoverable is updated.
verify: Open the recovery file and read the expected recoverable and the attached note.
Pass when the note is attached and the recoverable reflects the haircut.

generic.Defined scope/population: The gross recoverable on this file adjusted for fault, pursuit cost, deductible and limits.
generic.In-scope period: Computed after fault apportionment and refreshed before any settlement is agreed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Fault share, pursuit cost, deductible share and any limits ceiling are all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Net recoverable equals gross times fault share less pursuit cost and deductible share.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calculation stored with computation date, preparer name and the source figures relied on.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cost estimates that are provisional are marked as such with a refresh date.
generic.Test population: Every input line feeding the net recoverable computation on this file.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero files continue in active pursuit with a net recoverable below the pursuit threshold.
generic.Exception handling path: Files below threshold route to a documented close or exception approval before pursuit continues.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when fault, cost, deductible and limits inputs each trace to a recorded source.
generic.Evidence location: Net recoverable calculation on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Apply the assessed adverse fault percentage to gross recoverable
sop: Read gross recoverable and the adverse fault percentage from the recovery file.
Multiply gross recoverable by the adverse fault share.
Record the fault-adjusted figure as the first calculation line.
Done when the fault-adjusted figure is recorded with both inputs shown.
verify: Recompute the product from the recorded gross and fault share.
Pass when the recomputation equals the recorded fault-adjusted figure.

steps.title: Deduct expected pursuit cost
sop: Estimate expert fees, filing fees and any approved contingency fee percentage.
Deduct the total pursuit cost from the fault-adjusted figure.
Record each cost component and its source on the calculation.
Done when pursuit cost is deducted with components itemised.
verify: Compare itemised cost components against the engagement and fee records.
Pass when every cost component ties to a recorded engagement or fee schedule.

steps.title: Deduct the insured deductible share owed on distribution
sop: Read the insured deductible share from the deductible calculation on the file.
Deduct it so the insurer net position is shown clearly.
Record the deductible share as a separate calculation line.
Done when the deductible share is deducted and shown separately.
verify: Compare the deducted share against the deductible calculation on the file.
Pass when the two figures agree exactly.

steps.title: Apply any adverse policy-limit ceiling
sop: Read the adverse carrier limits confirmed on the adverse party record.
Cap the collectible amount at the available limits where they bind.
Record the limits ceiling and its source confirmation.
Done when the limits ceiling is applied or recorded as not binding.
verify: Compare the capped figure against the confirmed adverse limits.
Pass when the net recoverable does not exceed the confirmed available limits.

steps.title: Record the final net recoverable on the recovery file
sop: Total the calculation lines into the final net recoverable figure.
Write the figure and computation date to the payment/subrogation system.
Attach the calculation showing every input line.
Done when the net recoverable and calculation are on the recovery file.
verify: Re-add the calculation lines against the recorded net recoverable.
Pass when the lines total the recorded net recoverable exactly.

steps.title: Compare net recoverable to the minimum pursuit threshold
sop: Compare the net recoverable against the published minimum-pursuit threshold.
Record a documented continue or close decision on the comparison.
Route below-threshold continuations for exception approval.
Done when the threshold comparison and decision are recorded.
verify: Filter active files for a net recoverable below the threshold.
Pass when every such file holds a recorded exception approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: The liability, damages and defense analysis for this recovery file consolidated into one memo.
generic.In-scope period: Drafted after fault apportionment and before the demand or arbitration decision is taken.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Chronology, venue rule, fault percentages, figures table and recommendation are all present.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Figures in the memo table equal the gross, net and pursuit-cost figures on the recovery file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Memo stored with draft date, author name and version number on the recovery file.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Open factual or legal questions are listed in the memo with an owner and a resolution date.
generic.Test population: Every section of the memo checked against the underlying file evidence.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Memo carries an explicit recommendation of pursue, arbitrate, refer or close.
generic.Exception handling path: Memos with unresolved legal questions route to Legal Counsel before the recommendation is acted on.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when every numbered chronology entry cites an exhibit and the figures table reconciles.
generic.Evidence location: Liability assessment memo attached to the recovery file in the claim file repository.

steps.title: Set out the numbered loss chronology with exhibit references
sop: Draft the loss facts as a numbered chronology from first event to loss discovery.
Cite the exhibit number from the evidence index against each entry.
Flag any entry resting on an unresolved factual conflict.
Done when every chronology entry carries an exhibit reference or a conflict flag.
verify: Check each numbered entry for an exhibit reference or a flag.
Pass when no entry is left without either.

steps.title: State duty, breach and causation for each party
sop: For each party, state the duty owed and the breach alleged.
Link the breach to the damage through the recorded causation theory.
Cite the supporting exhibit for each element stated.
Done when duty, breach and causation are stated for every party.
verify: Compare the parties in the memo against the liability chain on the file.
Pass when every party on the chain appears in the memo.

steps.title: Record the venue rule and fault percentages applied
sop: State the venue negligence rule and any bar threshold in the memo.
Reproduce the fault percentages assigned to each party.
Confirm the percentages match the apportionment note on the file.
Done when the venue rule and matching percentages appear in the memo.
verify: Compare the memo percentages against the apportionment note.
Pass when the percentages agree exactly.

steps.title: Build the figures table for gross, net and pursuit cost
sop: Set gross recoverable, net recoverable and cost-to-pursue in a single table.
Read each figure from the recovery file rather than restating from memory.
Show the as-of date beside the figures.
Done when the figures table is complete with an as-of date.
verify: Compare each table figure against the recovery file record.
Pass when every table figure matches the file to the cent.

steps.title: List each surviving defense and its estimated haircut

State the combined effect of the haircuts on expected recovery.
Note any defense the adverse party has already asserted in correspondence.

steps.title: Close with an explicit recommendation and file the memo

generic.Defined scope/population: The expert discipline and scope required to evidence cause and origin on this loss.
generic.In-scope period: Engagement completed before evidence condition degrades or destructive testing is needed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Expert name, discipline, conflict check, scope, deadline and fee cap are all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Expert cost recorded as pursuit expense equals the fee cap agreed in the engagement letter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Executed engagement letter stored with execution date and the approved panel reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Off-panel appointments are logged with the documented exception and its approver.
generic.Test population: All expert engagements raised against this recovery matter.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero expert invoices approved for off-panel experts without a documented exception.
generic.Exception handling path: Conflict check failures stop the instruction and route to an alternative panel expert.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Retained when scope, deliverable format, deadline and fee cap are all defined in writing.
generic.Evidence location: Engagement letter in the legal matter management system linked to the recovery file.

steps.title: Confirm the expert discipline matches the loss
sop: Read the loss facts and identify the technical question to be answered.
Select fire cause-and-origin, electrical, metallurgy or accident reconstruction accordingly.
Record the discipline and the question on the engagement request.
Done when the discipline and the technical question are recorded.
verify: Compare the selected discipline against the loss type on the claim.
Pass when the discipline fits the loss type recorded on the claim.

steps.title: Select an expert from the approved panel
sop: Filter the approved panel in the legal matter management system by discipline and venue.
Check availability against the required deliverable deadline.
Record the selected expert and the panel reference.
Done when a panel expert is selected and recorded.
verify: Check the selected expert against the approved panel register.
Pass when the expert is on panel or an exception approval is recorded.

steps.title: Run a conflict check against all parties
sop: Check the expert against the adverse party, insured and manufacturer names.
Check prior instructions by the adverse carrier on related matters.
Record the conflict check outcome before any instruction is issued.
Done when the conflict check outcome is recorded on the matter.
verify: Check the engagement record for a conflict check dated before instruction.
Pass when the conflict check predates the instruction date.

steps.title: Issue the engagement letter with scope, deadline and fee cap
sop: Draft the engagement letter defining scope, deliverable format and deadline.
State the fee cap and the billing guidelines that apply.
Issue for signature and store the executed letter on the matter.
Done when the executed engagement letter is stored on the matter.
verify: Open the executed letter and check scope, deadline and fee cap are present.
Pass when all three terms appear and the letter is signed.

steps.title: Instruct the expert on evidence preservation and joint inspection
sop: Instruct the expert to preserve evidence condition during examination.
Require notice to the adverse party before any destructive testing.
Record the preservation instruction on the recovery file.
Done when the preservation instruction is issued and recorded.
verify: Check the file for a preservation instruction dated before any testing.
Pass when the instruction predates any destructive testing recorded.

steps.title: Record the expert cost as a pursuit expense
sop: Raise the expert fee cap as a pursuit expense on the recovery file.
Confirm the expense feeds the net recoverable calculation.
Set a diary to reconcile actual invoices against the fee cap.
Done when the expert cost is recorded as a pursuit expense on the file.
verify: Compare the pursuit expense on the file against the engagement fee cap.
Pass when the recorded expense equals the agreed fee cap.

generic.Defined scope/population: The causal chain linking the third-party act or defect to the damage claimed on this file.
generic.In-scope period: Established after the loss chronology is complete and before the demand letter is drafted.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Proximate cause, mechanism, cited exhibits and the rebutted alternative cause are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Each causal link in the theory maps to at least one exhibit on the evidence index.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Causation note stored with the author name, date and the expert report version relied on.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Causal links without supporting evidence are flagged as assumptions with a closure action.
generic.Test population: Every causal link asserted in the theory plus every alternative cause considered.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: At least one alternative cause is identified and rebutted in the causation note.
generic.Exception handling path: Unsupported links route to further evidence gathering before the demand is drafted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the theory is consistent with the expert findings and every link cites an exhibit.
generic.Evidence location: Causation theory note on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: State the proximate cause and the damage mechanism
sop: Read the loss chronology and expert findings held on the recovery file.
State the proximate cause and the mechanism producing the damage claimed.
Record the statement on the causation note.
Done when proximate cause and mechanism are stated on the note.
verify: Compare the stated mechanism against the expert report conclusion.
Pass when the stated mechanism is consistent with the expert report.

steps.title: Tie each causal link to a specific exhibit
sop: Break the theory into discrete causal links from act to damage.
Cite the expert report, photograph, statement or maintenance record for each link.
Flag any link with no exhibit as an assumption.
Done when every link cites an exhibit or is flagged as an assumption.
verify: Check each link on the note for a cited exhibit or an assumption flag.
Pass when no link is left uncited and unflagged.

steps.title: Identify and rebut at least one alternative cause
sop: List plausible alternatives such as pre-existing damage or maintenance failure.
Rebut each alternative using the evidence on file.
Record the alternative and the rebuttal on the causation note.
Done when at least one alternative cause is stated and rebutted.
verify: Read the note for an alternative cause and its rebuttal.
Pass when at least one alternative is identified and rebutted.

steps.title: Confirm the damages claimed follow from the cause alleged
sop: Compare the damage items claimed against the mechanism described.
Remove any item attributable to pre-loss condition or unrelated damage.
Record the damages consistency conclusion on the note.
Done when every damage item is confirmed consistent with the cause alleged.
verify: Compare the damages schedule against the causation note conclusion.
Pass when no damage item is inconsistent with the stated cause.

steps.title: Review the theory against the expert findings
sop: Read the causation note alongside the expert report on the matter.
Identify any point where the theory overstates the expert conclusion.
Record the review outcome and any required amendment.
Done when the review outcome is recorded on the causation note.
verify: Check the note for a recorded counsel review before the demand is drafted.
Pass when the review predates the demand draft date.

steps.title: Attach the causation theory to the recovery file
sop: Finalise the causation note with author, date and version.
Attach it to the recovery file in the claim file repository.
Link the note to the liability assessment memo for reuse in the demand.
Done when the causation note is attached and linked to the memo.
verify: Open the recovery file and confirm the causation note resolves.
Pass when the note opens and shows author, date and version.

generic.Defined scope/population: The damaged property or vehicle and the loss scene relevant to third-party liability.
generic.In-scope period: Attendance within 72 hours of assignment for property losses, before the scene is cleared.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Inspection date, photographs, measurements, impact direction and attendees are all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Photograph count in the report matches the images stored in the claim document repository.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Photographs stored with capture timestamps and the inspection report dated and signed.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Scenes already cleared before attendance are logged with the resulting evidence gap.
generic.Test population: All inspection evidence captured for this loss including photographs and measurements.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero inspection photographs stored outside the claim document repository.
generic.Exception handling path: Late attendance triggers reliance on third-party photographs with the limitation recorded.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when scene, damage detail, impact point and identifying plates are all photographed.
generic.Evidence location: Scene inspection report and images in the claim file repository against the claim number.

steps.title: Attend the loss scene within 72 hours of assignment
sop: Arrange attendance before the scene is cleared or repairs begin.
Confirm site access and safety requirements with the site controller.
Record the attendance date and time on the claim record.
Done when attendance is completed and the date and time are recorded.
verify: Compare the attendance timestamp against the assignment date.
Pass when attendance occurred within 72 hours or the delay reason is recorded.

steps.title: Photograph the scene, damage detail and identifying plates
sop: Capture overall scene, damage detail and the point of impact or origin.
Photograph serial numbers, model plates, VIN or registration where present.
Upload all images to the claim file repository against the claim number.
Done when all four photograph categories are captured and uploaded.
verify: Check the repository for images in each of the four categories.
Pass when all four categories are present and stored in the repository.

steps.title: Record measurements, impact direction and damage pattern
sop: Take measurements of damage extent and the impact or origin position.
Record the impact direction and whether the pattern fits the alleged cause.
Write the findings into the inspection report.
Done when measurements and pattern findings are in the inspection report.
verify: Compare the recorded pattern against the causation theory on the file.
Pass when the pattern findings are consistent with the alleged cause or the conflict is noted.

steps.title: Tag components for expert examination
sop: Identify components the expert will need to examine.
Tag each with claim number and item number and block their disposal.
Record the tagged item list on the inspection report.
Done when every component needed for examination is tagged and listed.
verify: Compare tagged items against the expert scope on the engagement letter.
Pass when every component in the expert scope appears on the tagged list.

steps.title: Record attendees and any joint-inspection invitation
sop: Record whether an adverse party or carrier representative attended.
Where none attended, record that a joint-inspection invitation was issued.
Attach the invitation correspondence to the claim file repository.
Done when attendees or the invitation record are captured on the report.
verify: Check the report for an attendee list or a recorded invitation.
Pass when either an attendee list or an invitation record is present.

steps.title: File the inspection report against the claim
sop: Finalise the inspection report with date, inspector name and photograph index.
File it to the claim file repository linked to the claim number.
Notify the specialist that the inspection evidence is available.
Done when the dated inspection report is filed against the claim.
verify: Compare the report photograph index count against images in the repository.
Pass when the index count equals the images stored for the claim.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every party in the chain of responsibility for the loss event on this recovery file.
generic.In-scope period: Mapped before the demand target and refreshed as new parties emerge from evidence.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Party name, duty owed, breach alleged, evidence reference and collectability rank are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Parties in the chain equal the parties on the adverse party record with no omissions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Liability chain document stored with mapping date, author and the contracts relied on.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Parties considered and excluded are recorded with the reason they carry no duty.
generic.Test population: All parties named in the loss facts, contracts and inspection evidence.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every party in the chain carries a duty, a breach and an evidence reference.
generic.Exception handling path: Parties with unclear vicarious exposure escalate to Legal Counsel before demand targeting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when vicarious routes and indemnity flows are tested and collectability is ranked.
generic.Evidence location: Liability chain document on the recovery file in the claim file repository.

steps.title: List every party in the chain of responsibility
sop: Read the loss chronology, contracts and inspection report for parties involved.
List driver, owner, employer, contractor, manufacturer and premises owner as applicable.
Record the list on the liability chain document.
Done when every party found in the evidence appears on the list.
verify: Cross-read the loss chronology for parties absent from the list.
Pass when every party named in the chronology appears on the list.

steps.title: State the duty and specific breach alleged per party
sop: For each listed party, state the duty owed to the insured or the public.
State the specific breach alleged rather than a generic negligence assertion.
Cite the exhibit that evidences the breach.
Done when duty, breach and exhibit are stated for every party.
verify: Check each party entry for duty, breach and exhibit.
Pass when all three are present for every party.

steps.title: Identify vicarious liability routes adding a solvent defendant
sop: Test respondeat superior, permissive use and statutory owner liability against the facts.
Record each vicarious route that attaches a solvent party to the chain.
Cite the doctrine or statute supporting each route.
Done when every vicarious route is recorded with its legal basis.
verify: Check each vicarious route on the document for a cited basis.
Pass when no vicarious route is asserted without a citation.

steps.title: Check contractual indemnity and additional-insured status
sop: Read contracts between the parties for indemnity and additional-insured wording.
Record which party owes indemnity to which and on what terms.
Attach the relevant contract pages to the claim file repository.
Done when indemnity flows are mapped and the contract pages attached.
verify: Compare the mapped indemnity flows against the attached contract wording.
Pass when every mapped flow is supported by attached contract wording.

steps.title: Rank the parties by collectability
sop: Classify each party as carrier-backed, self-insured, uninsured or judgment-proof.
Rank the parties so the demand targets the solvent or insured party first.
Record the ranking and the basis on the liability chain document.
Done when every party carries a collectability rank.
verify: Read the ranking against the demand target recorded on the file.
Pass when the demand targets the highest-ranked collectable party.

steps.title: Attach the liability chain to the recovery file
sop: Finalise the liability chain document with date, author and version.
Attach it to the recovery file in the claim file repository.
Reconcile the party list against the adverse party record in the subrogation system.
Done when the chain is attached and reconciles to the adverse party record.
verify: Compare the chain party list to the adverse party record.
Pass when the two lists agree with no party missing from either.

generic.Defined scope/population: Physical items retained from the loss scene for examination or evidential use.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items lost or damaged in storage are logged with the incident date and notification made.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero preserved items disposed of before the preservation hold is formally released.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Preserved when each item is tagged, stored, logged and blocked from salvage disposal.
generic.Evidence location: Chain-of-custody log in the claim file repository against the claim number.

steps.title: Tag each retained item at the point of collection
sop: Attach a tag showing claim number, item number, collection date and collector name.
Photograph the tagged item in situ before removal.
Record the item on the retained item list in the claim record.
Done when every retained item is tagged, photographed and listed.
verify: Compare the retained item list against the items tagged at inspection.
Pass when the two lists agree with no untagged retained item.

steps.title: Move items to secured storage and record the facility
sop: Transfer the tagged items to the approved secured storage facility.
Record facility name, container reference and any environmental conditions required.
Confirm the facility acknowledges receipt of each item.
Done when every item is in secured storage with the location recorded.
verify: Check each item on the list for a recorded storage location.
Pass when no retained item lacks a storage location.

steps.title: Maintain the chain-of-custody log with signed transfers
sop: Record every transfer with date, from-custodian and to-custodian.
Obtain a signature from the receiving custodian on each transfer.
Store the log against the claim number in the claim file repository.
Done when the custody log shows an unbroken signed sequence per item.
verify: Read the custody log for unsigned or missing transfer entries.
Pass when every transfer carries a receiving custodian signature.

steps.title: Block salvage sale and vehicle disposal on the claim
sop: Set the disposal block on the claim in the Claims management platform.
Notify the salvage vendor in writing that disposal is suspended.
Record the block and the notification on the claim record.
Done when the disposal block is active and the vendor is notified.
verify: Check the salvage status on the claim while the hold is open.
Pass when no sale or disposal is recorded during an open hold.

steps.title: Set the retention diary to the statute-of-limitations date
sop: Read the statute expiry date from the recovery file.
Set the item retention diary to that date rather than routine claim retention.
Record the retention basis alongside the diary entry.
Done when retention is diarised to the statute date for every item.
verify: Compare the retention diary date against the statute expiry.
Pass when the retention diary is no earlier than the statute expiry.

steps.title: Release the hold only on written authorisation
sop: Confirm no further examination, arbitration or suit requires the items.
Issue the written hold release naming the items covered.
Record the release on the custody log and lift the disposal block.
Done when a written release is recorded before any disposal proceeds.
verify: Check disposed items for a preceding written hold release.
Pass when every disposal is preceded by a written release on the log.

generic.Defined scope/population: The sequence of events from first cause through to loss discovery on this claim.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Factual gaps are listed with a diary action and an owner to close them.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero unresolved factual conflicts left unflagged in the chronology.

steps.title: Build the timestamped chronology from statements and reports
sop: Collect the loss notice, statements, police report and system data from the claim file.
Order the events by timestamp from first event to loss discovery.
Name the source document for each entry.
Done when the ordered chronology exists with a source per entry.
verify: Check each chronology entry for a named source.
Pass when no entry is left without a named source.

steps.title: Obtain recorded statements from the insured and witnesses
sop: Take recorded statements from the insured and any witnesses within the 14-day standard.
Store the recordings and transcripts in the claim file repository.
Add the statement content to the chronology with the statement reference.
Done when statements are taken and reflected in the chronology.
verify: Compare the statement dates against the loss notification date.
Pass when statements were taken within 14 days or the delay reason is recorded.

steps.title: Corroborate the chronology against objective data
sop: Retrieve telematics, CCTV, dispatch logs, weather or maintenance records as available.
Compare each objective source against the chronology sequence.
Record the corroboration outcome per entry.
Done when every available objective source has been compared and recorded.
verify: Check the chronology for entries with an unrecorded corroboration outcome.
Pass when every entry with an available objective source shows an outcome.

steps.title: Flag inconsistencies between accounts explicitly
sop: Compare the insured account against the police report and adverse party version.
Flag every material inconsistency in the chronology rather than smoothing it over.
State the significance of each inconsistency for the liability position.
Done when every inconsistency is flagged with its significance stated.
verify: Read the chronology for conflicting entries without a flag.
Pass when no conflicting entry is left unflagged.

steps.title: Identify remaining factual gaps and set diary actions
sop: List the facts still unknown that bear on liability or damages.
Set a diary action and a named owner to close each gap.
Confirm the gaps close before the demand draft date.
Done when every gap carries a diary action and an owner.
verify: Check each listed gap for an owner and a diary date.
Pass when every gap holds both and the dates precede the demand target.

steps.title: Attach the dated chronology to the recovery file
sop: Finalise the chronology with build date, author and version number.
Attach it to the recovery file in the claim file repository.
Link it to the liability assessment memo for reuse.
Done when the dated chronology is attached and linked to the memo.
verify: Open the recovery file and confirm the chronology resolves with a date.
Pass when the chronology opens and shows build date, author and version.

generic.Defined scope/population: The negligence, limitation and doctrine rules applying in the venue governing this recovery.
generic.In-scope period: Rules in force as at the date of loss and as at the intended filing date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Venue, fault rule, bar threshold, limitation period and applicable doctrines are all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Each cause of action on the file has a recorded limitation period in the research note.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Research note stored with research date, author and the authorities cited.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unsettled points of law are recorded with the risk they pose and the position taken.
generic.Test population: Every cause of action and every potentially liable party venue on this file.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Research note cites the fault rule, limitation period and applicable doctrines for the venue.
generic.Exception handling path: Choice-of-law conflicts route to a documented counsel position before apportionment proceeds.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when a one-page practical instruction is issued that the specialist can apply.
generic.Evidence location: Venue research note in the legal matter management system linked to the recovery file.

steps.title: Confirm the controlling venue and choice of law
sop: Compare the loss location, insured domicile and adverse party domicile.
Determine the controlling venue and the governing law where they differ.
Record the venue determination and the reasoning in the research note.
Done when the controlling venue and governing law are recorded.
verify: Check the recorded venue against the loss location and party domiciles.
Pass when the determination is supported by the recorded reasoning.

steps.title: Document the comparative or contributory fault rule
sop: Identify the fault rule applied in the venue and any bar threshold.
Cite the statute or leading authority establishing the rule.
Record the rule and threshold in the research note.
Done when the fault rule and threshold are recorded with a citation.
verify: Check the recorded rule against the cited authority.
Pass when the citation supports the rule as recorded.

steps.title: Record limitation periods and tolling exceptions per cause of action
sop: List each cause of action available on the file.
Record the limitation period and any discovery-rule or tolling exception for each.
Cite the statute setting each period.
Done when every cause of action holds a recorded period and citation.
verify: Compare the causes listed against the liability chain on the file.
Pass when every cause on the chain holds a recorded limitation period.

steps.title: Note venue doctrines affecting recovery
sop: Test made-whole, anti-subrogation, economic-loss and statutory lien rights in the venue.
Record whether each doctrine applies and its effect on recovery.
Cite the authority for each doctrine conclusion.
Done when all four doctrine areas are addressed with citations.
verify: Check the note for a conclusion on each of the four doctrine areas.
Pass when all four carry a conclusion and a citation.

steps.title: Issue a one-page practical instruction to the specialist
sop: Summarise the practical effect of the research in one page.
State clearly how the specialist should apply it to fault apportionment.
Issue the instruction to the assigned specialist and record the issue date.
Done when the one-page instruction is issued and dated.
verify: Open the instruction and check it states the apportionment approach.
Pass when the instruction gives an applicable apportionment approach.

steps.title: File the research note against the recovery file
sop: Attach the research note and instruction to the recovery file document repository.
Link the note reference on the recovery file in the subrogation system.
Confirm the apportionment step reads the note before assigning percentages.
Done when the research note is attached and linked to the recovery file.
verify: Open the recovery file and confirm the research note resolves.
Pass when the note opens and shows venue, fault rule and limitation period.

generic.Defined scope/population: The policy and statutory grounds supporting recovery on this file, plus any conditions precedent.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy clause reference, statutory route, release check and conditions precedent are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Each recovery route asserted maps to a cited clause or statute in the validation note.

steps.title: Read the transfer-of-rights clause in the date-of-loss policy
sop: Open the date-of-loss policy form attached to the recovery file.
Read the transfer-of-rights clause and confirm it covers the coverage part paid.
Quote the clause reference in the validation note.
Done when the clause reference is quoted against the paid coverage part.
verify: Compare the quoted clause against the attached policy form.

steps.title: Confirm the statutory recovery route and notice prerequisites
sop: Identify whether a lien, direct action or no-fault reimbursement route applies.

verify: Check each recorded prerequisite for a matching diary entry.
Pass when every prerequisite holds a diary entry.

steps.title: Check the insured has signed no release or settlement
sop: Search the claim file for any release, waiver or settlement signed by the insured.
Ask the insured to confirm no separate settlement has been agreed.
Record the outcome and attach any document found.
Done when the release check outcome is recorded on the validation note.
verify: Check the validation note for a recorded release check outcome.
Pass when the outcome is recorded and any release found blocks the demand.

steps.title: Confirm assignment and proof-of-loss conditions are satisfied
sop: Identify any assignment or proof-of-loss condition precedent in the policy.
Confirm the condition has been satisfied and evidence it on the file.
Record any unsatisfied condition as a blocking item.
Done when every condition precedent is confirmed satisfied or flagged.
verify: Check each identified condition for a satisfaction record or a block flag.
Pass when no condition is left without either.

steps.title: Record conditions to be met before the demand is served
sop: List any remaining condition to satisfy before demand service.
Assign an owner and a due date to each condition.
Set the demand workflow to block until the conditions clear.
Done when the pre-demand conditions are listed with owners and dates.
verify: Check the demand workflow status against the open conditions.
Pass when the demand remains blocked while any condition is open.

steps.title: Record the validated basis on the recovery file
sop: Write the validated rights conclusion to the recovery file in the subrogation system.
Attach the validation note to the claim file repository.
Set the validation status to resolved or unresolved explicitly.
Done when the validation status and note are recorded on the file.
verify: Filter files with an issued demand for an unresolved validation status.

verify: Read the receivable balance after the posting run.

steps.title: Confirm the insured deductible reimbursement is settled
sop: Check the deductible obligation status on the recovery file.

Done when the deductible position is settled and evidenced.
verify: Read the deductible obligation status on the file.

sop: Check the ceded-recovery notification and the booked ceded share on the file.
Confirm salvage allocations are posted to the correct bucket.

Done when ceded and salvage allocations are confirmed booked.
verify: Compare the notified ceded share against the booked allocation.

steps.title: Set the closure reason and net recovered value

verify: Compare attached exhibit numbers against the evidence index.

steps.title: Project the cost and cycle time of arbitration or suit

verify: Read the executed release for wording releasing unrelated claims.

sop: Determine whether the deductible is included in or carved out of the release.
