generic.Test population: All claimed damages lines plus all salvage and prior recovery credits on the claim.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero claimed amounts include a deductible or salvage figure counted twice.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmatched claimed lines are removed or evidenced before the damages figure is filed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Verified when every line ties to a ledger entry and no component is double-counted.
generic.Evidence location: Damages reconciliation on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Reconcile the claimed amount line by line to the payment ledger
sop: Extract the claim payment ledger from the Claims management platform.
Match each claimed damages line to a ledger entry.
List any claimed line with no matching ledger entry.
Done when every claimed line is matched or listed as unmatched.
verify: Read the unmatched line list after the reconciliation.
Pass when the unmatched list is empty or every entry is evidenced.

steps.title: Confirm the deductible is claimed once only
sop: Check whether the deductible sits inside the demand total or as a separate line.
Confirm it does not appear in both places.
Record the deductible treatment on the reconciliation.
Done when the deductible treatment is recorded and single-counted.
verify: Search the claimed lines for a duplicated deductible amount.
Pass when the deductible appears exactly once in the claim.

steps.title: Deduct salvage proceeds and prior partial recoveries
sop: Query realised salvage proceeds and any prior recovery on the claim.
Deduct both from the claimed amount.
Record the deduction references on the reconciliation.
Done when salvage and prior recoveries are deducted and referenced.
verify: Compare the deducted amounts against the ledger salvage and recovery credits.
Pass when the deductions equal the ledger credits.

steps.title: Remove expense not recoverable under the forum rules
sop: Read the forum rules on recoverable expense categories.
Remove internal handling cost and any other barred expense.
Record each removal with the rule that bars it.
Done when every barred expense is removed and logged.
verify: Check remaining expense lines against the forum recoverable categories.
Pass when every remaining expense line is a permitted category.

steps.title: Confirm reinsurance and coinsurance shares are not double-claimed
sop: Check whether any loss component is also claimed through reinsurance recovery.
Confirm coinsurance shares are claimed once across the parties.
Record the conclusion on the reconciliation.
Done when the reinsurance and coinsurance check is recorded.
verify: Compare claimed components against the ceded share notified to reinsurance.
Pass when no component appears in both claims.

steps.title: Record the verified damages figure on the recovery file
sop: Total the verified lines into the final damages figure.
Write the figure and the reconciliation date to the recovery file.
Confirm the arbitration filing will use this figure.
Done when the verified damages figure is recorded on the file.
verify: Compare the verified figure against the amount to be filed.
Pass when the filed amount equals the verified damages figure.

generic.Defined scope/population: The insured deductible component of the loss included in the recovery demand.
generic.In-scope period: Applied at demand drafting and refreshed if the demand amount is revised.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Deductible applied, demand total, deductible portion and insured notification are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Demand total equals the insurer paid amount plus the insured deductible portion.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Demand calculation stored with the date, preparer and the claim payment record referenced.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cases where the deductible is pursued separately are logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: The deductible component of every demand issued on this recovery file.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero demands claiming a deductible different from the deductible applied on the claim.
generic.Exception handling path: Deductible mismatches hold the demand until the claim payment record is reconciled.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Applied when the demand separates insurer and insured shares and the insured is on notice.
generic.Evidence location: Demand calculation on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Read the applied deductible from the claim payment record
sop: Open the claim payment record in the Claims management platform.
Read the deductible applied for the specific coverage part paid.
Record the figure on the demand calculation.
Done when the applied deductible figure is recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded figure against the claim payment record.
Pass when the two figures are identical.

steps.title: Add the deductible to the demand total
sop: Add the deductible to the insurer paid amount to form the demand total.
Show the insurer share and the insured share as separate lines.
Record the demand total on the recovery file.
Done when the demand total shows both shares separately.
verify: Sum the two shares against the recorded demand total.
Pass when the shares total the demand amount exactly.

steps.title: State on the demand that the deductible is included
sop: Insert wording stating the demand includes the insured deductible.
Make clear the adverse carrier should not pay the insured separately.
Record the wording used on the demand draft.
Done when the inclusion wording appears in the demand.
verify: Read the demand draft for the deductible inclusion wording.
Pass when the wording is present and unambiguous.

steps.title: Apply the same fault percentage to the deductible portion
sop: Read the adverse fault percentage from the apportionment note.
Apply it equally to the insurer and insured portions of the demand.
Record the adjusted portions on the calculation.
Done when both portions carry the same fault adjustment.
verify: Compare the fault percentage applied to each portion.
Pass when the same percentage applies to both portions.

steps.title: Notify the insured that the deductible is included in the pursuit
sop: Tell the insured their deductible is being pursued as part of the demand.
Explain that reimbursement depends on the recovery actually received.
Record the notification date on the recovery file.
Done when the insured notification is recorded on the file.
verify: Check the recovery file for a recorded insured notification.
Pass when the notification is recorded with a date.

steps.title: Reconcile the demand deductible to the claim record
sop: Compare the deductible amount in the demand to the claim payment record.
Hold the demand where the two differ until reconciled.
Record the reconciliation outcome on the recovery file.
Done when the demand deductible reconciles to the claim record.
verify: Compare demand deductible and claim deductible on issued demands.
Pass when no issued demand shows a deductible different from the claim.

generic.Defined scope/population: The insured share of the total recovery attributable to the deductible on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: Calculated when recovery is received and recalculated on any later instalment.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Deductible base, total loss claimed, amount recovered, method and resulting share are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Insured share plus insurer share equals the amount actually recovered.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calculation stored with the calculation date, preparer and the method applied.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deviations from the standard method are logged with the approval that permits them.
generic.Test population: Every deductible share calculation performed on this recovery file.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Deductible base equals the deductible actually applied, not the policy deductible amount.
generic.Exception handling path: Made-whole venues switch to insured-first distribution before the share is finalised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Calculated when the base, the recovery amount and the method are each recorded on the file.
generic.Evidence location: Deductible share calculation on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Take the deductible actually applied as the numerator base
sop: Read the deductible actually applied from the claim payment record.
Do not use the policy deductible amount where it differs.
Record the base and its source on the calculation.
Done when the deductible base is recorded with its source.
verify: Compare the base against the claim payment record deductible.
Pass when the base equals the deductible actually applied.

steps.title: Compute the share against the total loss claimed
sop: Divide the deductible base by the total loss claimed.
Apply the resulting fraction to the amount actually recovered.
Record the inputs and the resulting share on the calculation.
Done when the share is computed and its inputs recorded.
verify: Recompute the share from the recorded inputs.
Pass when the recomputation equals the recorded share.

steps.title: Confirm the distribution method for the jurisdiction
sop: Determine whether the venue or company practice reimburses first or pro rata.
Record the method chosen and the source that governs it.
Apply the method consistently across the calculation.
Done when the distribution method is recorded and applied.
verify: Compare the applied method against the recorded governing source.
Pass when the method applied matches the governing source.

steps.title: Deduct the insured proportionate pursuit cost only where permitted
sop: Check whether the published approach allows a pursuit cost deduction.
Deduct the insured proportionate share only where allowed.
Record the deduction or the reason none was made.
Done when the pursuit cost treatment is recorded.
verify: Compare the deduction applied against the published approach.
Pass when the deduction is applied only where the approach permits it.

steps.title: Record the reimbursement figure on the recovery file
sop: Record the calculated share, the method used and the reimbursement figure.
Attach the working to the recovery file in the subrogation system.
Confirm the disbursement step will use this figure.
Done when the reimbursement figure and working are on the file.
verify: Compare the reimbursement figure against the calculation working.
Pass when the figure follows from the recorded working.

steps.title: Reconcile insured and insurer shares to the recovery received
sop: Sum the insured share and the insurer share.
Compare the total against the amount actually recovered.
Correct any residual before the disbursement is raised.
Done when the two shares total the amount recovered.
verify: Sum the shares against the recovery receipt amount.
Pass when the shares total the receipt with no residue.

generic.Defined scope/population: Partial recovery receipts on this claim requiring a pro-rata split of the deductible.
generic.In-scope period: From the partial receipt clearing until any later instalment or supplemental recovery.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Recovery factor, deductible share, insurer share and made-whole conclusion are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Insured and insurer pro-rata shares total the partial amount actually recovered.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Pro-rata working stored with the receipt reference and calculation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Made-whole venues that override pro-rata are logged with the venue rule cited.
generic.Test population: Every partial recovery receipt allocated on this recovery file.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero partial recoveries allocating the deductible in full where the venue applies pro rata.
generic.Exception handling path: Later instalments trigger recalculation and a top-up to the insured share.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Calculated when the factor is applied symmetrically and the venue rule is recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Pro-rata allocation working on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Confirm the receipt is a partial settlement
sop: Compare the receipt against the agreed settlement amount on the file.
Confirm whether a further instalment is expected.
Record the partial status and any expected instalment.
Done when the partial status and instalment expectation are recorded.
verify: Compare the receipt against the agreed settlement amount.
Pass when the receipt is less than the agreed amount and marked partial.

steps.title: Compute the pro-rata factor
sop: Divide the amount recovered by the total amount claimed.
Record the resulting pro-rata factor on the working.
Show both inputs so the factor can be re-derived.
Done when the pro-rata factor is computed and its inputs recorded.
verify: Recompute the factor from the recorded inputs.
Pass when the recomputed factor matches the recorded figure.

steps.title: Apply the factor to the deductible share
sop: Multiply the deductible base by the pro-rata factor.
Record the resulting insured deductible share.
Attach the working to the recovery file.
Done when the pro-rata deductible share is recorded.
verify: Recompute the deductible share from base times factor.
Pass when the recomputation matches the recorded share.

steps.title: Apply the same factor to the insurer indemnity share
sop: Multiply the insurer indemnity claimed by the same pro-rata factor.
Confirm the split is symmetric between insured and insurer.
Record the insurer share on the working.
Done when the insurer share carries the same factor.
verify: Sum the insured and insurer shares against the receipt.
Pass when the shares total the receipt amount exactly.

steps.title: Check whether the made-whole rule overrides pro rata
sop: Read the made-whole conclusion from the venue research on the file.
Where made-whole applies, pay the insured share ahead of the insurer share.
Record the distribution order applied on the working.
Done when the venue rule and distribution order are recorded.
verify: Compare the distribution order against the venue made-whole conclusion.
Pass when the order applied matches the venue rule recorded.

steps.title: Set a recalculation diary for later instalments
sop: Set a diary to recalculate on receipt of any later instalment.
Note that the insured share is topped up on supplemental recovery.
Confirm the diary is loaded in the payment/subrogation system.
Done when the recalculation diary is set on the recovery file.
verify: Check partial-recovery files for a recalculation diary entry.
Pass when every partial-recovery file with an expected instalment holds the diary.

generic.Defined scope/population: The deductible obligation recorded on this recovery file awaiting closure.
generic.In-scope period: From reimbursement disbursement clearing to the closure of the deductible obligation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Obligation status, disbursed amount, disbursement date and residual balance are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Deductible balance on the recovery file nets to zero after the disbursement posts.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Closure entry stamped with the closer name, closure date and payment reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Obligations closed as not applicable carry a recorded reason rather than a blank status.
generic.Test population: All deductible obligations on recovery files closed in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero closed recovery files carrying a non-zero outstanding deductible balance.
generic.Exception handling path: Returned or stale-dated payments reopen the obligation and reissue the disbursement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Closed when the payment has cleared, the balance is zero and the diary is cleared.
generic.Evidence location: Deductible obligation status on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Confirm the reimbursement payment has cleared
sop: Check the disbursement status in the payment/subrogation system.
Confirm the payment is not returned, stale-dated or unpresented.
Record the cleared date on the obligation record.
Done when the cleared status and date are recorded.
verify: Read the payment status after the clearing window.
Pass when the payment shows cleared and not returned.

steps.title: Set the obligation status to closed with amount and date
sop: Set the deductible obligation status to closed.
Record the disbursed amount and the disbursement date.
Stamp the closer name on the obligation record.
Done when the obligation status reads closed with amount and date.
verify: Filter closed obligations for a blank amount or date.
Pass when the filter returns zero rows.

steps.title: Confirm the deductible balance nets to zero
sop: Read the deductible balance on the recovery file after posting.
Investigate any residual amount before closure completes.
Record the zero balance confirmation on the obligation.
Done when the deductible balance is confirmed at zero.
verify: Read the deductible balance on the closed obligation.
Pass when the balance reads zero.

steps.title: Record a not-applicable reason where no deductible is due
sop: Where no deductible applies, record the reason on the obligation.
Set the status explicitly rather than leaving it blank.
Cite the policy or recovery fact that removes the obligation.
Done when a not-applicable reason is recorded where none is due.
verify: Filter obligations with no disbursement for a not-applicable reason.
Pass when every such obligation carries a recorded reason.

steps.title: Clear the deductible diary on the recovery file
sop: Clear the outstanding deductible diary entries on the file.
Confirm the file drops off the outstanding-reimbursement report.
Record the diary clearance on the obligation.
Done when the deductible diary is cleared on the file.
verify: Search the outstanding-reimbursement report for the closed file.
Pass when the closed file no longer appears on the report.

steps.title: Post the closed obligation to the parent claim
sop: Write the closed deductible obligation to the claim record.
Confirm the claim shows the reimbursement amount and closure date.
Notify the claim handler that the obligation is closed.
Done when the parent claim shows the closed obligation.
verify: Open the parent claim and read the deductible obligation status.
Pass when the claim shows closed with a matching amount and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Deductible reimbursement disbursements to insureds arising from cleared recoveries.
generic.In-scope period: Issued within five business days of the recovery clearing the ledger.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Payee name, remittance detail, screening result, amount and payment reference are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Disbursed amount equals the calculated deductible share for the recovery received.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Payee verification and screening evidence attached with the disbursement timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Priority lien or loss-payee interests are logged with the redirection they require.
generic.Test population: All deductible reimbursement disbursements raised in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero disbursements released to a payee that failed or bypassed sanctions screening.
generic.Exception handling path: Screening hits or unverified remittance detail halt release pending manual review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Disbursed when payee is verified, screening cleared and no priority interest is outstanding.
generic.Evidence location: Disbursement record with screening evidence on the recovery file in the subrogation system.

steps.title: Verify the payee against the named insured on the policy
sop: Compare the payee name against the named insured on the policy record.
Confirm remittance details were verified out of band with the insured.
Record the verification evidence on the disbursement record.
Done when payee verification evidence is attached.
verify: Compare the payee against the policy named insured.
Pass when the payee matches or a documented assignment is attached.

steps.title: Complete sanctions and watch-list screening
sop: Screen the payee against sanctions and watch lists.
Attach the screening result to the disbursement record.
Halt the disbursement on any hit and route to manual review.
Done when a screening result is attached before release.
verify: Check the screening timestamp against the release timestamp.
Pass when a clear screening result predates the release.

steps.title: Confirm no lien or loss-payee interest takes priority
sop: Check the policy and claim for lienholder or loss-payee interests.
Confirm none takes priority over the insured reimbursement.
Record the priority check outcome on the disbursement.
Done when the priority check outcome is recorded.
verify: Read the priority check outcome on the disbursement record.
Pass when the outcome is recorded and no priority interest is unresolved.

steps.title: Issue the payment within five business days of clearing
sop: Raise the payment in the payment/subrogation system for the calculated amount.
Release it within five business days of the recovery clearing.
Record the payment reference and date on the recovery file.
Done when the payment is issued with a reference and date recorded.
verify: Compare the payment date against the recovery cleared date.
Pass when payment occurred within five business days or a delay reason is recorded.

steps.title: Post the disbursement to the deductible recovery bucket
sop: Post the disbursement against the deductible recovery bucket in the ERP ledger.
Confirm the posting keeps allocation reporting accurate.
Record the ledger reference on the recovery file.
Done when the disbursement is posted to the deductible bucket.
verify: Read the ledger bucket on the disbursement posting.
Pass when the posting sits in the deductible recovery bucket.

steps.title: Confirm the disbursement against the claim record
sop: Write the reimbursement amount and date to the claim record.
Confirm the claim shows the insured has been reimbursed.
Notify the claim handler of the disbursement.
Done when the claim shows the reimbursement amount and date.
verify: Compare the claim reimbursement entry against the disbursement record.
Pass when the claim entry matches the disbursement amount and date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The insured notification of deductible recovery outcome on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: Sent once the recovery outcome is known and before or with the reimbursement payment.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Recovery outcome, reimbursement amount, payment date and remittance confirmation are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Amount stated to the insured equals the calculated deductible share on the file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notification copy filed with the send date logged as a claim activity.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Undeliverable notifications are logged with the failure reason and the resend action.
generic.Test population: All insured notifications issued on this recovery file.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every notification states the recovery outcome and the reimbursement amount or the reason none is due.
generic.Exception handling path: Unconfirmed remittance details hold the payment date promise until verified.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Notified when the outcome is stated plainly and the pro-rata basis is explained where partial.
generic.Evidence location: Notification copy in the claim file repository with the activity logged on the claim.

steps.title: State plainly whether the deductible was recovered
sop: Read the recovery outcome and the deductible share from the recovery file.
State in plain language whether it was recovered in full, in part or not at all.
Avoid technical subrogation terms the insured will not follow.
Done when the outcome is stated plainly in the notification draft.
verify: Read the draft for a plain statement of the recovery outcome.
Pass when the outcome is stated without technical jargon.

steps.title: State the reimbursement amount and expected payment date
sop: Read the calculated reimbursement amount from the recovery file.
State the amount and the expected payment date in the notification.
Where none is due, state the reason instead of the amount.
Done when the amount and date, or the not-due reason, appear in the draft.
verify: Compare the stated amount against the calculated deductible share.
Pass when the stated amount equals the calculated share.

steps.title: Explain the pro-rata basis where the recovery was partial
sop: Where only part was recovered, explain the pro-rata basis in plain language.
Show the recovery factor applied to the deductible.
Confirm the explanation matches the pro-rata working on the file.
Done when the pro-rata basis is explained in the notification.
verify: Compare the explanation against the pro-rata working.
Pass when the explanation reflects the working on the file.

steps.title: Confirm the insured remittance details before promising a date
sop: Contact the insured to confirm current remittance details.
Record the confirmation on the claim record.
Hold the payment date promise until the details are confirmed.
Done when remittance details are confirmed and recorded.
verify: Check the claim for a recorded remittance confirmation before the notification.
Pass when the confirmation predates the promised payment date.

steps.title: Send the notification to the insured
sop: Send the notification through the insured preferred contact channel.
Retain any delivery confirmation available.
Record the send date on the claim record.
Done when the notification is sent and the send date recorded.
verify: Check the claim for a recorded send date.
Pass when the send date is recorded and the channel noted.

steps.title: File the notification copy and log the claim activity
sop: File the notification copy to the claim file repository.
Log the send as a claim activity in the Claims management platform.
Link the activity to the recovery file record.
Done when the copy is filed and the activity is logged.
verify: Open the filed copy from the claim activity link.
Pass when the copy resolves and states the recovery outcome and amount.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full deductible reimbursement document set for this claim held for audit and examination.
generic.In-scope period: Retention measured from claim closure for the claims retention period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Calculation, receipt, disbursement confirmation, notification and index entries are all present.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documents indexed equal the documents required by the retention standard for the reimbursement.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Each document indexed with its date and version against the claim number.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing documents are logged with the retrieval action and the responsible owner.
generic.Test population: Every document in the deductible reimbursement set for this claim.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero reimbursement documents stored only outside the claim document repository.
generic.Exception handling path: Routine deletion is suppressed while any litigation hold on the matter remains open.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archived when the set is indexed against the claim number and retrievable by an examiner.
generic.Evidence location: Indexed reimbursement document set in the claim file repository under the claim number.

steps.title: Assemble the calculation, receipt and disbursement confirmation
sop: Collect the deductible calculation working, the recovery receipt and the disbursement confirmation.
Confirm the three documents relate to the same recovery and amount.
Group them as one indexed set on the claim.
Done when the three core documents are grouped as one set.
verify: Compare the amounts across the three documents.
Pass when the amounts agree across calculation, receipt and disbursement.

steps.title: Add the insured notification and any dispute correspondence
sop: Add the insured notification copy to the document set.
Add any correspondence where the insured disputed the amount.
Index each addition with its date and type.
Done when the notification and any dispute correspondence are in the set.
verify: Check the set index for the notification and dispute items.
Pass when the notification appears and any dispute item is indexed.

steps.title: Apply the retention period measured from claim closure
sop: Read the claims retention period applicable to the line of business.
Set retention from claim closure rather than from the payment date.
Record the calculated retention expiry on the document set.
Done when the retention expiry is recorded from claim closure.
verify: Compare the retention expiry against the claim closure date plus the period.
Pass when the expiry follows from claim closure, not the payment date.

steps.title: Index every document against the claim number
sop: Index each document in the set against the claim number in the repository.
Confirm a market-conduct examiner could retrieve the set by claim number.
Fix any document stored without a claim number index.
Done when every document is indexed against the claim number.
verify: Search the repository by claim number and count the returned documents.
Pass when the search returns every document in the set.

steps.title: Suppress routine deletion while a litigation hold is open
sop: Check whether a litigation hold remains open on the matter.
Suppress routine deletion for the set while the hold stands.
Record the suppression against the document set.
Done when deletion is suppressed for any set under an open hold.
verify: Check sets under an open hold for an active deletion suppression.
Pass when every held set shows deletion suppressed.

steps.title: Confirm the archived set is complete and retrievable
sop: Retrieve the set from the repository as an examiner would.
Confirm every required document opens and is legible.
Record the completeness check on the recovery file.
Done when the completeness check is recorded on the file.
verify: Open each document from the retrieved set.
Pass when every document opens and is legible.

generic.Defined scope/population: The insured uncompensated loss tested against the recovery before any insurer share is retained.
generic.In-scope period: Assessed at each recovery receipt before the distribution is raised.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Venue rule, uncompensated loss total, recovery amount and distribution order are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Insured uncompensated components total the amount tested against the recovery.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Made-whole assessment stored with the assessment date and the venue authority cited.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policies validly contracting out of made-whole are logged with the clause reference.
generic.Test population: All insured uncompensated loss components on this claim.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero insurer shares retained ahead of the insured share in a made-whole venue on a partial recovery.
generic.Exception handling path: Insufficient recoveries pay the insured share first and record the insurer shortfall.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Confirmed when the venue rule and the distribution order are both recorded before disbursement.
generic.Evidence location: Made-whole assessment on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Determine whether the venue applies the made-whole doctrine
sop: Read the venue research note for the made-whole conclusion.
Check whether the policy validly contracts out of the doctrine.
Record the conclusion and the authority relied on.
Done when the made-whole position for the venue is recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded conclusion against the cited authority.
Pass when the conclusion is supported by the cited authority.

steps.title: Total the insured uncompensated loss
sop: Add the deductible, uninsured betterment, loss of use and any excess above limits.
Evidence each component from the claim record.
Record the total uncompensated loss on the assessment.
Done when the uncompensated loss total is recorded with components.
verify: Sum the recorded components against the stated total.
Pass when the components total the recorded figure.

steps.title: Compare the recovery against the uncompensated loss
sop: Compare the amount recovered against the insured uncompensated loss.
Determine whether the insured is made whole by the recovery.
Record the comparison result on the assessment.
Done when the comparison result is recorded.
verify: Recompute the comparison from the recovery and the uncompensated total.
Pass when the recomputation matches the recorded result.

steps.title: Pay the insured share first where the recovery is insufficient
sop: Where the recovery is insufficient, allocate to the insured share first.
Record the insurer shortfall arising from the priority.
Confirm the distribution order on the allocation record.
Done when the insured-first order is applied and the shortfall recorded.
verify: Read the allocation order on partial recoveries in made-whole venues.
Pass when the insured share precedes the insurer share in those files.

steps.title: Record the distribution order before the disbursement is raised
sop: Record the made-whole conclusion and the distribution order on the file.
Confirm the disbursement step reads the recorded order.
Block the disbursement until the order is recorded.
Done when the distribution order is recorded before disbursement.
verify: Compare the disbursement date against the assessment date.
Pass when the assessment predates the disbursement on every file.

steps.title: Attach the assessment to the recovery file
sop: Attach the made-whole assessment to the recovery file document repository.
Link it to the deductible calculation and the allocation record.
Confirm the assessment is retrievable for audit.
Done when the assessment is attached and linked on the file.
verify: Open the assessment from the recovery file link.
Pass when the assessment resolves and states the venue rule and order.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open recovery receivables carrying a balance at the ageing run date.
generic.In-scope period: Balances outstanding as at the period-end cut-off used for the ageing run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Ageing band, days outstanding, debtor type and balance are populated on every receivable.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ageing total reconciles to the recovery receivable control balance in the general ledger.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Ageing report saved with run date, cut-off date and the preparer name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Receivables that cannot be aged for a missing start date are logged with a data fix owner.
generic.Test population: Every open recovery receivable at the ageing cut-off date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero open receivables missing from the ageing report.
generic.Exception handling path: Balances past 180 days route to the write-off review queue automatically.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Current when the ageing reconciles to the ledger and the debtor-type split is complete.
generic.Evidence location: Recovery receivable ageing report for the period in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Extract open receivables at the period cut-off
sop: Extract all open recovery receivables from the payment/subrogation system.
Apply the period-end cut-off date consistently across the extract.
Record the row count and total balance on the run record.
Done when the extract is taken with a recorded count and total.
verify: Compare the extract count against open receivables in the system.
Pass when the extract count equals the open receivable count.

steps.title: Age each balance from the demand or award date
sop: Use the demand issue date or the award date as the ageing start.
Assign each balance to the 0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 91-180 or 180-plus band.
Flag receivables with no valid start date for a data fix.
Done when every receivable carries an ageing band or a data flag.
verify: Filter the ageing for receivables without a band.
Pass when every unbanded receivable carries a data fix flag.

steps.title: Reconcile the ageing total to the general ledger control balance
sop: Compare the ageing total against the recovery receivable control in the ERP ledger.
Investigate and explain any variance found.
Record the reconciliation and variance explanation on the report.
Done when the ageing total is reconciled to the ledger control.
verify: Read the reconciliation variance on the report.
Pass when the variance is nil or fully explained.

steps.title: Split the ageing by debtor type
sop: Classify each debtor as carrier, self-insured, uninsured individual or vendor.
Split the ageing bands by debtor type since collection profiles differ.
Confirm the split totals the ageing total.
Done when the debtor-type split is produced and totals reconcile.
verify: Sum the debtor-type split against the ageing total.
Pass when the split totals the ageing total exactly.

steps.title: Flag balances past 180 days for write-off review
sop: Select receivables in the 180-plus band.
Flag each for the write-off review queue.
Record the flag date on the receivable.
Done when every 180-plus balance carries a write-off review flag.
verify: Compare the 180-plus band count against the write-off review queue additions.
Pass when every 180-plus balance appears in the review queue.

steps.title: Publish the ageing to the unit manager
sop: Name the top overdue balances with debtor and days outstanding.
Publish the ageing report against the period in the subrogation system.
Notify the unit manager that the report is available.
Done when the ageing report is published for the period.
verify: Open the published report and check run date and cut-off are stamped.
Pass when both are stamped and the top overdue balances are named.

generic.Defined scope/population: The recovery proceeds received on this file awaiting allocation across the recovery formula.
generic.In-scope period: Allocated in the accounting period in which the cash is received and cleared.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Deductible line, expense line, indemnity line and ceded share line are all populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Allocation lines total exactly the cash received with no rounding residue.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Allocation record stored with the allocation date, preparer and the receipt reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unallocated residues are logged with the reason and cleared before period close.
generic.Test population: Every allocation line raised against this recovery receipt.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero allocated totals differing from the cash actually received on the recovery file.
generic.Exception handling path: Interface suspense items are cleared in the same close cycle before allocation completes.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Booked when the distribution order is applied and the ledger interface clears cleanly.
generic.Evidence location: Proceeds allocation record on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Apply the distribution order to the proceeds
sop: Apply insured deductible share, then pursuit expense, then insurer indemnity.
Apply the reinsurance ceded share last per the recovery formula.
Record the order applied on the allocation record.
Done when the distribution order is applied and recorded.
verify: Compare the applied order against the recovery formula on the file.
Pass when the order matches the recorded formula.

steps.title: Allocate the salvage component separately
sop: Identify any salvage proceeds component within the receipt.
Allocate it to the salvage bucket rather than to indemnity recovery.
Record the salvage allocation reference on the file.
Done when salvage is allocated separately from indemnity recovery.
verify: Check the indemnity bucket for a salvage amount.
Pass when no salvage proceeds sit in the indemnity recovery bucket.

steps.title: Calculate the reinsurance ceded recovery share
sop: Read the treaty terms for the loss occurrence year.
Calculate the ceded recovery share net of any ceded expense allowance.
Record the ceded share and the treaty reference on the allocation.
Done when the ceded share is calculated and referenced.
verify: Recompute the ceded share against the treaty terms.
Pass when the recomputation matches the recorded ceded share.

steps.title: Confirm the allocation lines total the cash received
sop: Sum the allocation lines and compare against the cash received.
Clear any rounding residue rather than leaving it unallocated.
Record the total confirmation on the allocation record.
Done when the allocation lines total the cash received exactly.
verify: Sum the allocation lines against the receipt amount.
Pass when the lines total the receipt with no residue.

steps.title: Book the allocation entries to the general ledger
sop: Post the allocation entries in the payment/subrogation system.
Run the interface to the ERP general ledger.
Check the interface log for suspense or rejected items.
Done when the allocation entries have posted to the ledger.
verify: Read the interface log after the allocation run.
Pass when no suspense or rejected item remains for the allocation.

steps.title: Report the allocation outcome to the recovery unit
sop: Summarise the allocation across deductible, expense, indemnity and ceded share.
Report the summary to the recovery unit for file updating.
Record the summary against the recovery file.
Done when the allocation summary is recorded against the file.
verify: Compare the summary lines against the booked allocation entries.
Pass when the summary matches the booked entries.

generic.Defined scope/population: Identified recovery receipts awaiting application to a named recovery file.
generic.In-scope period: Applied in the same close cycle in which the receipt is identified.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Remittance reference, recovery file, bucket allocation and residual balance are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Applied amount equals the receipt and the receivable reduces by the same amount.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Application record stored with the application date and the remittance reference used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Receipts partially applied are logged with the residual and the reason it remains.
generic.Test population: All recovery receipts applied in the current close cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero receipts remaining in unapplied cash beyond the current close cycle.
generic.Exception handling path: Bulk remittances require a claim-level schedule before any application proceeds.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Applied when the receipt matches by reference and the bucket allocation is recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Receipt application record on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Match the receipt by the agreed remittance reference
sop: Read the remittance reference on the incoming receipt.
Match it to the reference recorded in the settlement payment terms.
Do not match by amount alone where the reference is absent.
Done when the receipt is matched by reference to a recovery file.
verify: Compare the matched file reference against the settlement terms reference.
Pass when the two references agree.

steps.title: Split bulk carrier remittances by recovery file
sop: Obtain the remittance schedule breaking the bulk payment down by claim.
Split the receipt across the individual recovery files it covers.
Confirm the split totals the bulk payment amount.
Done when the bulk receipt is split across its constituent files.
verify: Sum the split amounts against the bulk receipt total.
Pass when the splits total the bulk receipt exactly.

steps.title: Apply the receipt across deductible, indemnity and expense buckets
sop: Read the allocation formula from the recovery file.
Apply the receipt across the deductible, indemnity and expense buckets.
Record the bucket amounts on the application record.
Done when the bucket-level allocation is recorded.
verify: Sum the bucket amounts against the applied receipt.
Pass when the buckets total the applied amount.

steps.title: Reduce the recovery receivable by the applied amount
sop: Read the receivable balance before and after application.
Confirm the reduction equals the amount applied.
Record whether the residual balance is intended or an under-payment.
Done when the receivable movement and residual position are recorded.
verify: Compare the receivable movement against the applied amount.
Pass when the movement equals the applied amount.

steps.title: Clear the item from unapplied cash in the same close cycle
sop: Check the unapplied cash account for the receipt after application.
Clear any remaining unapplied portion before the cycle closes.
Record the clearing entry reference on the recovery file.
Done when no portion of the receipt remains in unapplied cash.
verify: Search unapplied cash for the receipt reference after the close run.
Pass when the search returns no remaining balance for the receipt.

steps.title: Confirm the application to the general ledger
sop: Interface the application entries to the ERP general ledger.
Confirm the journal posted in the open period without suspense.
Record the ledger journal reference on the recovery file.
Done when the application journal has cleared to the ledger.
verify: Read the interface log for suspense or rejected lines.
Pass when the log shows no suspense or rejected line for the application.

generic.Defined scope/population: Recovery receivables aged beyond 180 days queued for write-off review.
generic.In-scope period: The current write-off review cycle covering balances flagged by the ageing run.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Collection actions attempted, collectability evidence, statute position and recommendation are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Balances reviewed equal the balances flagged as 180-plus in the ageing report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Review record stored with review date, reviewer name and the evidence attached per balance.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Balances deferred for further collection are logged with the next action and diary date.
generic.Test population: Every receivable in the 180-plus ageing band at the review date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero write-offs above the delegated threshold lacking recorded manager approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Still-enforceable balances return to collections rather than being written off prematurely.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete when each balance holds a recommendation and supporting collectability evidence.
generic.Evidence location: Write-off review record on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Pull all receivables aged beyond 180 days
sop: Extract receivables in the 180-plus band from the ageing report.
List the collection actions already attempted on each balance.
Record the extract count on the review record.
Done when the aged extract is taken with collection history listed.
verify: Compare the extract count against the 180-plus band count.
Pass when the counts agree.

steps.title: Test collectability evidence for each balance
sop: Test for debtor insolvency, untraceable address, statute expiry or upheld denial.
Attach the supporting evidence for the collectability conclusion reached.
Record the conclusion against each balance.
Done when every balance carries a collectability conclusion with evidence.
verify: Check each balance for a conclusion and attached evidence.
Pass when no balance is left without both.

steps.title: Confirm the statute-of-limitations position
sop: Read the statute expiry date on each recovery file under review.
Confirm no still-enforceable claim is written off prematurely.
Record the statute position against each balance.
Done when the statute position is recorded for every balance.
verify: Filter write-off recommendations for balances still inside the statute.
Pass when every such recommendation states an alternative justification.

steps.title: Recommend write-off, pursuit or external collections per balance
sop: Recommend write-off, continued pursuit or collections referral for each balance.
State the reasoning tied to the collectability and statute conclusions.
Record the recommendation and owner on the review record.
Done when every balance holds a recommendation with reasoning.
verify: Check each reviewed balance for a recommendation.
Pass when no reviewed balance is left without a recommendation.

steps.title: Route write-offs above threshold to manager approval
sop: Compare each recommended write-off against the delegated authority threshold.
Route above-threshold items for manager approval before any ledger entry.
Record the approval reference against each item.
Done when every above-threshold write-off holds a recorded approval.
verify: Filter recommended write-offs above threshold for approval references.
Pass when every above-threshold item holds an approval reference.

steps.title: Publish the write-off review outcome
sop: Summarise write-offs, continued pursuits and collections referrals recommended.
Publish the review record against the review cycle.
Notify the unit manager and the collections owner of the outcome.
Done when the review record is published for the cycle.
verify: Compare the published record count against the balances reviewed.
Pass when every reviewed balance appears in the published record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Overdue recovery balances past their agreed due date requiring dunning notices.
generic.In-scope period: From 30 days past due through the escalation ladder to referral or write-off.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Notice stage, send date, addressee, balance quoted and next escalation diary are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notices logged equal the overdue balances due a notice at each escalation stage.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notice copies retained with send date and the template version used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Balances suppressed from dunning are logged with the reason and the suppressing owner.
generic.Test population: All overdue recovery receivables in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero overdue receivables past 60 days with no dunning notice recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Balances referred to external collections have in-house dunning suspended to avoid parallel demands.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Issued when the notice quotes the reference, balance and remittance instructions.
generic.Evidence location: Dunning notice history on the receivable in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Trigger the first notice at 30 days past due
sop: Select balances 30 days past the agreed due date.
Generate the first notice quoting the settlement reference and the balance.
Send to the adverse handler and log the notice on the receivable.
Done when first notices are sent and logged for all 30-day balances.
verify: Filter balances 30 days past due for a first notice record.
Pass when every such balance holds a first notice record.

steps.title: Escalate the addressee at 60 and 90 days
sop: At 60 days, escalate the notice from handler to carrier recovery manager.
At 90 days, escalate again with a final-notice tone before referral.
Log each escalation with the addressee and send date.
Done when the escalation ladder is applied at 60 and 90 days.
verify: Check balances past 60 and 90 days for the matching escalation notice.
Pass when every such balance holds the escalation notice for its band.

steps.title: Include payment reference and remittance instructions on every notice
sop: Include the agreed payment reference on every notice issued.
Include full remittance instructions so cash can be matched on receipt.
Confirm the reference matches the settlement payment terms.
Done when every notice carries the reference and remittance detail.
verify: Open a sample of notices and check for reference and remittance detail.
Pass when every sampled notice carries both.

steps.title: Use compliant wording when dunning an individual debtor
sop: Identify balances owed by individual debtors rather than carriers.
Apply the compliant consumer dunning template for those balances.
Record the template version used on the notice log.
Done when individual debtors receive the compliant template.
verify: Check notices to individual debtors for the compliant template version.
Pass when every individual-debtor notice uses the compliant template.

steps.title: Log each notice and set the next escalation diary
sop: Log each notice on the receivable with its send date and stage.
Set the next escalation diary from the stage just issued.
Assign the diary to the collections owner.
Done when every notice is logged with a next escalation diary.
verify: Check logged notices for a following escalation diary entry.
Pass when every logged notice holds a next escalation diary.

steps.title: Suppress dunning on balances referred to external collections
sop: Identify balances referred to an external collections agency.
Suppress in-house dunning on those balances.
Record the suppression and the referral reference.
Done when in-house dunning is suppressed on all referred balances.
verify: Check referred balances for in-house notices issued after referral.
Pass when no referred balance shows a post-referral in-house notice.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ceded-loss recoveries on claims attaching to treaty or facultative reinsurance placements.
generic.In-scope period: Notified within the contract-stated deadline after the recovery is booked.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Placement reference, ceded share, notification date and reinsurer reference are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notified ceded share equals the ceded share booked in the proceeds allocation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Transmission evidence retained with the notification date and the treaty year cited.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Placements that cannot be identified are logged with a chase to the reinsurance team.
generic.Test population: All ceded claims with a recovery booked in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero recoveries on ceded claims closed without a ceded-share notification.
generic.Exception handling path: Late or missed notifications escalate to the reinsurance manager the same day.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Sent when the calculated share is notified within the contract deadline and evidenced.
generic.Evidence location: Ceded-recovery notification reference on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Identify each treaty and facultative placement for the occurrence year
sop: Look up the placements attaching to the loss occurrence year.
Record the treaty and facultative references on the recovery file.
Chase the reinsurance team where a placement cannot be identified.
Done when every attaching placement is identified and recorded.
verify: Compare recorded placements against the placement register for the year.
Pass when every attaching placement appears on the recovery file.

steps.title: Calculate the ceded recovery share against the treaty terms
sop: Apply the treaty terms to the recovery amount for the occurrence year.
Net off any ceded pursuit expense allowance the treaty permits.
Record the calculated share and the treaty clause relied on.
Done when the ceded share is calculated and referenced to the treaty.
verify: Recompute the ceded share from the treaty terms and recovery amount.
Pass when the recomputation matches the recorded share.

steps.title: Notify the reinsurer within the contract deadline
sop: Issue the ceded-recovery notification to the reinsurer or broker.
Send within the contract-stated deadline for the placement type.
Retain the transmission evidence on the recovery file.
Done when the notification is sent with transmission evidence retained.
verify: Compare the notification date against the contract deadline.
Pass when notification occurred on or before the deadline.

steps.title: Confirm the offset posts to the reinsurance recoverable balance
sop: Post the ceded recovery offset to the reinsurance recoverable in the ERP ledger.
Confirm the posting hits the correct treaty and occurrence year.
Record the posting reference on the recovery file.
Done when the offset posts to the correct recoverable balance.
verify: Read the ledger account and treaty year on the offset posting.
Pass when the posting sits against the correct treaty and year.

steps.title: Reconcile the notified share to the booked allocation
sop: Compare the notified ceded share against the ceded line in the proceeds allocation.
Investigate and correct any divergence before close.
Record the reconciliation outcome on the recovery file.
Done when the notified and booked ceded shares reconcile.
verify: Compare the notified share against the booked allocation line.
Pass when the two figures agree.

steps.title: Record the reinsurer reference before file closure
sop: Capture the reference the reinsurer returns on acknowledgement.
Record it on the recovery file against the placement.
Block file closure until the reference or a non-response note is recorded.
Done when the reinsurer reference is recorded on the file.
verify: Filter closed ceded claims for a missing ceded-share notification.
Pass when no closed ceded claim lacks a notification record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Recovery entries to be booked in the claims financial system for the period.
generic.In-scope period: Postings made within the open accounting period with no back-dating into a closed period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Claim, coverage, loss component, recovery transaction type and source reference are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Paid loss net of recovery on each claim reduces by exactly the amount posted.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Posting batch retained with posting date, poster name and the source reference per entry.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected interface lines are logged with the rejection reason and the correction made.
generic.Test population: All recovery entries posted in the current period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero recovery journals left in the interface error or suspense queue after the run.
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected journals are corrected and reposted within the same accounting period.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Posted when the transaction type matches the recovery source and the ledger accepts the journal.
generic.Evidence location: Recovery posting batch in the payment/subrogation system with journals in the ERP ledger.

steps.title: Post the recovery against the correct claim and coverage
sop: Select the claim, coverage part and loss component for the recovery.
Post the recovery so loss ratios reflect it against the right component.
Record the posting reference on the recovery file.
Done when the recovery is posted against the correct coverage component.
verify: Read the coverage component on the posted entry.
Pass when the component matches the coverage under which the loss was paid.

steps.title: Use the recovery transaction type matching the source
sop: Select subrogation, salvage, deductible or reinsurance as the transaction type.
Avoid posting as a generic cash credit.
Record the type against the entry.
Done when every entry carries a source-specific transaction type.
verify: Filter posted entries for a generic credit transaction type.
Pass when the filter returns zero entries.

steps.title: Confirm the posting falls in the open accounting period
sop: Check the posting date against the open accounting period.
Reject any attempt to back-date into a closed period.
Record the period on the posting batch.
Done when every entry posts within the open period.
verify: Read the accounting period on each posted entry.
Pass when no entry sits in a closed accounting period.

steps.title: Verify paid loss net of recovery reduces by the posted amount
sop: Read paid loss net of recovery on the claim before and after posting.
Confirm the reduction equals the amount posted.
Investigate any difference before the batch closes.
Done when the claim net paid loss reduces by the posted amount.
verify: Compare the claim net paid movement against the posted amount.
Pass when the movement equals the posted amount.

steps.title: Interface the journal to the general ledger
sop: Run the interface from the claims financial system to the ERP ledger.
Check the interface log for rejected or suspense lines.
Correct and repost any rejected line in the same period.
Done when the journal is accepted with no rejected lines.
verify: Read the interface log after the posting run.
Pass when no line remains in the error or suspense queue.

steps.title: Record the posting batch with source references
sop: Record the batch with posting date, poster name and entry count.
Ensure each entry carries a traceable source reference.
Publish the batch record against the period.
Done when the posting batch record is published for the period.
verify: Sample entries in the batch for a traceable source reference.
Pass when every sampled entry carries a source reference.

generic.Defined scope/population: Overdue recovery receivables requiring direct collection contact with the debtor.
generic.In-scope period: From the first missed due date through to settlement, referral or write-off.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Contact channel, outcome, promise-to-pay amount and date, and next action are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Contact log entries equal the collection contacts made on the receivable.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Contact log entries stamped with contact date, contactor name and the person reached.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unreachable debtors are logged with the trace action and the escalation taken.
generic.Test population: All overdue recovery receivables worked in the collection cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero overdue receivables with a past-due promise-to-pay and no recorded follow-up.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresponsive carrier handlers escalate to the recovery manager or to arbitration.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Contact made when the channel, outcome and next action are each recorded on the log.
generic.Evidence location: Collection contact log on the receivable in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Contact the adverse carrier recovery handler directly
sop: Call or message the adverse carrier recovery handler on carrier balances.
Do not rely on written notices alone for carrier debts.
Log the contact with the person reached and the outcome.
Done when a direct contact is logged for each carrier balance.
verify: Check overdue carrier balances for a logged direct contact.
Pass when every overdue carrier balance holds a direct contact record.

steps.title: Record every promise to pay with amount and date
sop: Record the promised amount and the promised payment date.
Diary the follow-up on that date in the payment/subrogation system.
Confirm on the diary date whether the promise was kept.
Done when every promise to pay is recorded with a follow-up diary.
verify: Filter promises past their date for a recorded follow-up.
Pass when every past-due promise holds a recorded follow-up.

steps.title: Negotiate an instalment plan with individual debtors
sop: Where an individual cannot pay in full, offer an instalment plan.
Keep the plan inside the approved terms or seek manager approval.
Record the plan schedule and diary each instalment.
Done when the instalment plan is recorded and diarised.
verify: Check instalment plans against the approved terms.
Pass when every plan sits within approved terms or holds an approval.

steps.title: Escalate unresponsive handlers after two contacts
sop: Identify balances where the handler has not responded to two contacts.
Escalate to the carrier recovery manager or to arbitration.
Record the escalation decision and route on the receivable.
Done when every twice-contacted unresponsive balance holds an escalation.
verify: Filter balances with two contacts and no response for an escalation record.
Pass when every such balance holds an escalation record.

steps.title: Confirm the statute runway on every contact
sop: Read the statute expiry on the recovery file at each contact.
Refer the balance to suit before the runway lapses.
Record the runway on the contact log entry.
Done when every contact entry records the remaining runway.
verify: Check contact entries for a recorded statute runway.
Pass when every contact entry records the runway.

steps.title: Record the outcome and next action on the contact log
sop: Record the contact channel, the outcome and the next action.
Set the next action diary on the receivable.
Confirm the collections owner sees the diary.
Done when channel, outcome and next action are recorded.
verify: Check each contact log entry for channel, outcome and next action.
Pass when all three are present on every entry.

generic.Defined scope/population: Incoming recovery payments received into the insurer bank accounts awaiting identification.
generic.In-scope period: Receipts received in the current bank statement and cash application cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Remittance reference, recovery file or suspense flag, currency and net amount are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Identified plus suspense receipts equal the recovery receipts on the bank statement.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Identification outcome stored with the receipt date and the remittance advice reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unidentifiable receipts are parked in suspense with a chase action to the remitter.
generic.Test population: All incoming recovery receipts in the current cash application cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero unidentified recovery receipts in suspense past the agreed ageing limit without a chase.
generic.Exception handling path: Short payments are flagged as a shortfall rather than closing the receivable balance.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Identified when the receipt links to a recovery file or to suspense with a chase recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Receipt identification record in the payment/subrogation system for the cycle.

steps.title: Match the remittance advice reference to an open recovery file
sop: Read the remittance advice for each incoming recovery receipt.
Match the reference against open recovery files in the subrogation system.
Do not apply anything before a match or a suspense decision is made.
Done when each receipt is matched or marked for suspense.
verify: Compare matched receipts against the recovery file references.
Pass when every matched receipt resolves to an open recovery file.

steps.title: Obtain the schedule for bulk carrier remittances
sop: Request the schedule breaking the bulk payment down by claim.
Hold the receipt from posting until the schedule arrives.
Record the schedule reference against the receipt.
Done when a claim-level schedule is held for every bulk remittance.
verify: Check bulk receipts posted for a held schedule reference.
Pass when no bulk receipt was posted without a schedule.

steps.title: Identify short payments against the agreed amount
sop: Compare each receipt against the agreed settlement amount on the file.
Flag any shortfall rather than closing the receivable balance.
Record the shortfall amount and a chase action.
Done when every short payment is flagged with a chase action.
verify: Filter receipts below the agreed amount for a shortfall flag.
Pass when every short payment carries a shortfall flag and chase.

steps.title: Park unidentifiable receipts in suspense with a chase
sop: Park genuinely unidentifiable receipts in the suspense account.
Raise a chase to the remitter for the missing remittance detail.
Diary the suspense item against the agreed ageing limit.
Done when every suspense item holds a chase and a diary.
verify: Check suspense items for a chase record and a diary date.
Pass when every suspense item holds both.

steps.title: Confirm receipt currency and bank charges deducted
sop: Read the receipt currency and any bank charges deducted at source.
Confirm the net applied amount matches the cash actually received.
Record the currency and charge detail on the receipt record.
Done when currency and charge detail are recorded on the receipt.
verify: Compare the applied amount against the bank statement amount.
Pass when the applied amount equals the cash received net of charges.

steps.title: Record the identification outcome for every receipt
sop: Record identified or suspense as the outcome on every receipt.
Reconcile the outcomes against the bank statement recovery receipts.
Publish the identification summary for the cycle.
Done when every receipt carries a recorded identification outcome.
verify: Compare outcomes recorded against bank statement recovery receipts.
Pass when the counts reconcile with no receipt left unrecorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Recovery postings in the recovery system compared against recovery credits in the claim payment ledger.
generic.In-scope period: The financial close period being reconciled with a stated cut-off date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Recovery system total, ledger credit total, variance and variance explanation are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Receivable movement equals opening balance plus new demands less cash and write-offs.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed reconciliation stored with the close period, preparer and approver names.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Timing differences are logged separately from genuine posting errors.
generic.Test population: All recovery postings and ledger recovery credits within the close period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero unexplained variances between recovery system totals and the claim payment ledger.
generic.Exception handling path: Recoveries with no matching claim payment are investigated as mis-keyed claim numbers.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reconciled when every variance is explained and sign-off is recorded before ledger close.
generic.Evidence location: Signed recovery reconciliation for the close period in the ERP general ledger records.

steps.title: Extract recovery totals from both systems at the cut-off
sop: Extract total recoveries posted in the payment/subrogation system for the period.
Extract recovery credits from the claim payment ledger in the ERP.
Record both totals and the cut-off date on the reconciliation.
Done when both totals are extracted at a common cut-off.
verify: Compare the cut-off dates applied to each extract.
Pass when both extracts use the same cut-off date.

steps.title: Reconcile the two totals and quantify the variance
sop: Compare the recovery system total against the ledger credit total.
Quantify the variance and list the contributing items.
Record the variance on the reconciliation.
Done when the variance is quantified and itemised.
verify: Recompute the variance from the two recorded totals.

steps.title: Separate timing differences from posting errors

Classify the remainder as posting errors requiring correction.
Record the classification against each variance item.
Done when every variance item is classified.

steps.title: Investigate recoveries with no matching claim payment

Correct the claim reference and repost where confirmed.
Done when every unmatched recovery is investigated and resolved.

steps.title: Confirm the receivable movement equation
sop: Compute opening receivable plus new demands less cash and write-offs.
Compare the result against the closing receivable balance.
Record the movement reconciliation on the close pack.
Done when the movement equation reconciles to the closing balance.
verify: Recompute the movement equation from the recorded components.
Pass when the computed closing balance equals the actual balance.

steps.title: Obtain sign-off before the ledger closes
sop: Record all variance explanations on the reconciliation.
Route the reconciliation for sign-off before the ledger closes.
Store the signed reconciliation against the close period.
Done when the signed reconciliation is stored for the period.
verify: Check the reconciliation for a sign-off dated before ledger close.
Pass when sign-off is recorded before the close date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Uncollectible recovery balances proposed for referral to an external collections agency.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero balances referred to external collections while in-house dunning remains active.
generic.Exception handling path: Statute-expired balances are written off rather than referred to collections.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Referred when in-house steps are logged as exhausted and the agency terms are approved.
generic.Evidence location: Collections referral record on the recovery file in the payment/subrogation system.

steps.title: Confirm in-house dunning and contact attempts are exhausted
sop: Read the dunning notice history and the contact log on the receivable.
Confirm the escalation ladder and direct contacts are complete.
Record the exhaustion conclusion on the referral record.
Done when the in-house exhaustion conclusion is recorded.
verify: Check the dunning history for the full escalation ladder.
Pass when all escalation stages are logged before referral.

steps.title: Confirm the balance remains legally enforceable
sop: Read the statute expiry date on the recovery file.
Confirm the debt remains inside the limitation period.
Record the enforceability conclusion on the referral record.
Done when enforceability is confirmed and recorded.
verify: Compare the referral date against the statute expiry.
Pass when the referral date falls inside the limitation period.

steps.title: Select an approved agency and confirm the contingency fee
sop: Select a collections agency from the approved panel.
Confirm the contingency fee percentage sits within approved terms.
Record the agency name and fee on the referral record.
Done when the agency and fee are recorded within approved terms.
verify: Compare the agreed fee against the approved fee range.
Pass when the fee sits within the approved range.

steps.title: Transmit the debt file with substantiating documents
sop: Assemble the settlement agreement, demand and proof of loss.
Transmit the debt file to the agency through the agreed channel.
Retain the transmission confirmation on the recovery file.
Done when the substantiating debt file is transmitted and confirmed.
verify: Check the transmitted file contains agreement, demand and proof of loss.
Pass when all three documents are in the transmitted package.

steps.title: Suspend in-house dunning on referral

Record the suspension date on the receivable.
Done when in-house dunning is suspended on the referred balance.
verify: Check referred balances for in-house notices after the referral date.
Pass when no in-house notice follows the referral date.

steps.title: Diary the agency reporting cycle
sop: Set a diary at the agency reporting cycle to review progress.
Record the expected recovery rate for later vendor scoring.
Assign the diary to the collections owner.
Done when the agency reporting diary is set on the receivable.
verify: Check referred balances for an agency reporting diary.
Pass when every referred balance holds a reporting diary.

generic.Defined scope/population: Reserves on the claim relating to amounts now recovered or no longer expected to be incurred.
generic.In-scope period: Reversal booked in the period the recovery receipt or award is recorded.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reserve movement amount, rationale, recovery reference and approval are all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reserve released equals the amount actually recovered with pursuit reserve retained.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reserve movement stamped with the movement date, approver and the recovery reference cited.
