generic.Test population: All reserve movements posted against this claim following a recovery.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero reserve movements above the approval threshold posted without manager approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Movements above the 25K change threshold route to the manager before posting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Booked when the rationale references the recovery receipt and no stale reserve remains.
generic.Evidence location: Reserve movement record on the claim in the Claims management platform.

steps.title: Release the recovery reserve for the amount actually recovered
sop: Read the amount actually recovered from the recovery file.
Release the recovery reserve only for that amount.
Retain reserve for any remaining pursuit on the file.
Done when the release matches the amount recovered.
verify: Compare the reserve released against the amount recovered.
Pass when the release equals the recovery with pursuit reserve retained.

steps.title: Reverse the expense reserve for costs no longer expected
sop: Identify pursuit costs no longer expected to be incurred.
Reverse the corresponding expense reserve on the claim.
Record the reversal amount and the reason.
Done when the expense reserve reversal is recorded.
verify: Compare the remaining expense reserve against outstanding pursuit actions.
Pass when the remaining reserve matches the outstanding pursuit plan.

steps.title: Obtain manager approval above the change threshold
sop: Compare the reserve movement against the 25K change threshold.
Route above-threshold movements to the manager before posting.
Record the approval reference on the movement.
Done when every above-threshold movement holds an approval.
verify: Filter reserve movements above the threshold for an approval reference.
Pass when every above-threshold movement holds an approval reference.

steps.title: Record the rationale linking the movement to the recovery
sop: Cite the recovery receipt or award reference in the movement rationale.
State why the reserve is no longer required at its prior level.
Record the rationale on the reserve movement.
Done when the rationale cites the specific recovery reference.
verify: Read the rationale for a recovery receipt or award reference.
Pass when the rationale cites a specific recovery reference.

steps.title: Confirm net incurred reflects the recovery
sop: Read net incurred on the claim after the reserve movement posts.
Confirm it reflects the recovery received.
Investigate any stale reserve still sitting on the claim.
Done when net incurred reflects the recovery with no stale reserve.
verify: Compare net incurred before and after the movement.
Pass when the change is consistent with the recovery and reserve release.

steps.title: Post the movement and record it against the recovery file
sop: Post the reserve movement in the Claims management platform.
Record the movement reference on the recovery file.
Confirm the movement appears in the period reserve reporting.
Done when the movement is posted and referenced on the recovery file.
verify: Open the recovery file and read the reserve movement reference.
Pass when the reference resolves to the posted movement.

generic.Defined scope/population: Uncollectible recovery balances approved for write-off in the current review cycle.

steps.title: Select the write-off reason code
sop: Select debtor insolvent, untraceable, statute expired, arbitration lost or uneconomic.
Record the code against the balance being written off.
Reject any write-off request with no reason code selected.
Done when every write-off carries a reason code.
verify: Filter write-off entries for a blank reason code.
Pass when the filter returns zero entries.

steps.title: Attach the evidence supporting the reason chosen
sop: Attach the insolvency notice, trace report or arbitration decision as applicable.
Confirm the evidence supports the reason code selected.
Store the evidence against the recovery file.
Done when supporting evidence is attached for each write-off.
verify: Check each write-off for evidence matching its reason code.
Pass when every write-off holds evidence consistent with the code.

steps.title: Confirm the approval sits at the matching authority level
sop: Compare the write-off value against the authority matrix.
Confirm the approver holds authority for that value.
Record the approval reference and approver on the entry.
Done when the approval level matches the write-off value.
verify: Compare the approver authority against the write-off value.
Pass when the approver authority covers the value written off.

steps.title: Post the write-off to the recovery bad-debt account
sop: Post the write-off to the recovery bad-debt account in the ERP ledger.
Do not reverse the original recovery credit.
Record the journal reference on the recovery file.
Done when the write-off is posted to bad debt with a journal reference.
verify: Read the ledger account on the write-off journal.
Pass when the journal posts to bad debt rather than reversing the credit.

steps.title: Confirm the ageing drops the written-off balance
sop: Re-run the receivable ageing after the write-off posts.

Record the ageing confirmation on the write-off entry.
Done when the ageing no longer carries the written-off balance.
verify: Search the ageing report for the written-off balance.
Pass when the balance is absent from the open ageing.

steps.title: Close the recovery file with the write-off reason
sop: Set the recovery file status to closed with the write-off reason code.
Record the net recovered value and the amount written off.
Post the closure to the parent claim record.
Done when the file is closed with the write-off reason recorded.
verify: Open the closed file and read the closure reason.
Pass when the closure reason matches the write-off reason code.

generic.Defined scope/population: Closed-paid claims that met a subrogation trigger but were never referred for recovery.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Root cause class, paid amount at risk, handling team and line of business are populated.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims that cannot be classified are logged as unknown cause with a follow-up owner.
generic.Test population: The sample of closed-paid claims meeting a trigger with no recovery referral.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every top root cause carries a named owner and a due date for remediation.
generic.Exception handling path: Statute-lapsed leakage is quantified separately as unrecoverable rather than deferred.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Documented when root causes are classified and the paid amount at risk is quantified.
generic.Evidence location: Leakage analysis for the period in the payment/subrogation system reporting area.

steps.title: Sample closed-paid claims that met a trigger but were never referred
sop: Join closed-paid claims to trigger-rule results in the enterprise data warehouse.
Select claims that met a trigger with no recovery referral raised.
Quantify the paid amount at risk across the sample.
Done when the missed-recovery sample and paid amount at risk are recorded.
verify: Check a sample of selected claims for a trigger hit and no referral.
Pass when every sampled claim meets both conditions.

steps.title: Classify each miss by root cause
sop: Read each sampled claim to determine why no referral was raised.
Classify as trigger not fired, adjuster did not refer, statute lapsed, evidence missing or referral rejected.
Record the classification and the supporting note per claim.
Done when every sampled claim carries a root cause classification.
verify: Filter the sample for claims with no classification.
Pass when every claim carries a classification or an unknown-cause flag.

steps.title: Quantify statute-lapsed leakage separately
sop: Split the leakage between statute-lapsed and still-actionable claims.
Report the statute-lapsed portion as unrecoverable value.
Record both figures in the leakage analysis.
Done when the leakage is split by actionability.
verify: Sum the two split figures against the total leakage.
Pass when the split totals the reported leakage.

steps.title: Break leakage down by handling team and line of business
sop: Attribute each missed claim to its handling team and line of business.
Show where the leakage concentrates across the two dimensions.
Record the breakdown in the analysis.
Done when the leakage breakdown by team and line is produced.
verify: Sum the breakdown against the total leakage figure.
Pass when the breakdown totals the reported leakage.

steps.title: Assign a named owner and due date to each top root cause
sop: Rank the root causes by leakage value.
Assign a named owner and due date to each top cause.
Record the actions on the recovery improvement log.
Done when every top root cause holds an owner and due date.
verify: Check each top root cause for an owner and a due date.
Pass when all top causes carry both.

steps.title: Feed the findings into rule calibration
sop: Convert root causes attributable to trigger gaps into candidate rule changes.
Pass the candidate changes to the calibration owner.
Record the handover on the leakage analysis.
Done when the calibration handover is recorded.
verify: Check the calibration backlog for the candidate rule changes.
Pass when every trigger-gap cause appears in the calibration backlog.

generic.Defined scope/population: Compiled recovery metrics for the period compared against the approved targets.

generic.Evidence location: Benchmark output in the payment/subrogation system reporting area for the period.

steps.title: Compare recovery rate against target by line of business
sop: Compute recovered divided by recoverable identified for each line of business.
Compare against the approved target for that line.
Record the actual, target and variance on the benchmark output.
Done when recovery rate is benchmarked for every line of business.
verify: Recompute the recovery rate for one line from its inputs.
Pass when the recomputed rate matches the benchmarked figure.

steps.title: Compare cycle time against target and prior period
sop: Compute average days from referral to recovery for the period.
Compare against the cycle-time target and the prior period.
Record all three figures on the benchmark output.
Done when cycle time is shown against target and prior period.
verify: Compare the prior period figure against the previous benchmark output.
Pass when the prior period figure matches the previously published value.

steps.title: Compare recovery expense ratio against target
sop: Compute pursuit cost divided by gross recovered for the period.
Compare against the approved expense ratio target.
Record the actual, target and variance.
Done when the expense ratio is benchmarked against target.
verify: Recompute the ratio from pursuit cost and gross recovered.
Pass when the recomputed ratio matches the benchmarked figure.

steps.title: Show variance in both absolute value and percentage
sop: Show each variance as an absolute value and as a percentage of target.
Avoid overweighting small-base metrics on percentage alone.
Record both forms on the benchmark output.
Done when every variance is shown in both forms.
verify: Check each benchmarked metric for both variance forms.
Pass when both forms appear for every metric.

steps.title: Write a driver explanation for every metric adrift by more than 10 percent
sop: Identify metrics more than 10 percent adrift of target.
Write a one-line driver explanation for each.
Record the explanations against the metrics.
Done when every adrift metric holds a driver explanation.
verify: Filter metrics adrift by more than 10 percent for an explanation.
Pass when every such metric carries an explanation.

steps.title: Publish the benchmark output for the period
sop: Stamp the period, target version and preparer on the benchmark output.
Publish it against the reporting period in the subrogation system.
Notify the unit manager and the metric owners.
Done when the benchmark output is published for the period.
verify: Open the published output and check the target version is stamped.
Pass when the target version and period are both stamped.

generic.Defined scope/population: The recovery results and improvement plan for the period presented to claims leadership.
generic.In-scope period: The completed reporting period against target and prior year.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Net recovered, recovery rate, cycle time, leakage and improvement plan status are present.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Net recovered in the briefing equals the ledger-reconciled figure in the metrics pack.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Briefing pack and minutes stored with the briefing date and attendee list.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deferred decisions are minuted with the reason and the date they return.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every action minuted carries an owner and a due date.
generic.Exception handling path: Metrics not reconciled to the ledger are excluded rather than presented unverified.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Delivered when the decisions and new actions are minuted onto the recovery file record.
generic.Evidence location: Briefing pack and minutes in the claim file repository for the reporting period.

steps.title: Open with net recovered against target and prior year
sop: Read the ledger-reconciled net recovered figure from the metrics pack.
Show it against target and prior year in a single headline figure.
Place it on the opening slide of the briefing pack.
Done when the headline net recovered figure opens the pack.
verify: Compare the headline figure against the reconciled metrics pack.
Pass when the headline equals the reconciled net recovered figure.

steps.title: Show recovery rate, cycle time and leakage as a three-metric summary
sop: Present recovery rate, cycle time and leakage together before any detail.
Show target and variance beside each metric.
Keep the summary to a single view.
Done when the three-metric summary appears before the detail.
verify: Check the pack order places the summary ahead of detail sections.
Pass when the summary precedes the detail.

steps.title: Call out the largest recoveries and write-offs with reasons
sop: List the largest single recoveries in the period with the recovery route used.
List the largest write-offs with the reason code applied.
Record both lists in the briefing pack.
Done when both lists appear with reasons stated.
verify: Compare the listed write-offs against the write-off register.
Pass when every listed write-off matches a register entry with the same reason.

steps.title: Present the improvement plan with RAG ratings and owners
sop: Show each improvement action with a RAG rating and a named owner.
Show the due date and the current status per action.
Record the plan view in the briefing pack.
Done when every action shows a RAG rating, owner and due date.
verify: Check each plan action for a RAG rating, owner and due date.
Pass when all three are present for every action.

steps.title: Deliver the briefing to claims leadership
sop: Present the pack to claims leadership at the scheduled session.
Record the attendee list and the briefing date.
Capture questions raised during the session.
Done when the briefing is delivered and attendees recorded.
verify: Check the briefing record for a date and attendee list.
Pass when both are recorded for the session.

steps.title: Minute decisions and new actions with owners and due dates
sop: Minute each decision taken and each new action agreed.
Record an owner and a due date against every action.
Store the minutes on the recovery file record.
Done when the minutes are stored with owners and due dates.
verify: Check each minuted action for an owner and a due date.
Pass when every action carries both.

generic.Defined scope/population: The subrogation trigger rule set calibrated against closed recovery file outcomes.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Recalibrated when per-rule precision and recall are measured and the version is approved.
generic.Evidence location: Calibration record in the payment/subrogation system against the rule set version.

steps.title: Join closed recovery outcomes back to the original trigger scores
sop: Extract closed recovery outcomes from the enterprise data warehouse.
Join each to the trigger score and rule that produced the candidate.
Record the joined population count on the calibration record.
Done when the joined outcome population is assembled and counted.
verify: Compare the joined count against closed recoveries in the window.
Pass when the joined count covers the closed recovery population.

steps.title: Measure precision and recall per rule
sop: Compute precision and recall for each trigger rule from the joined data.
Record the figures against each rule on the calibration record.
Highlight rules performing below the acceptance threshold.
Done when every rule holds a precision and recall figure.
verify: Check each deployed rule for a precision and recall figure.
Pass when no deployed rule is left unmeasured.

steps.title: Retire or re-weight high false-positive rules
sop: Identify rules producing high false-positive volume.
Retire or re-weight them rather than leaving them firing.
Record the change and the evidence that drove it.
Done when every high false-positive rule is retired or re-weighted.
verify: Check high false-positive rules for a recorded change.
Pass when every such rule shows a retirement or re-weighting.

steps.title: Add new trigger conditions from the leakage analysis
sop: Read the leakage root causes attributable to trigger gaps.
Draft new trigger conditions covering the missed claim patterns.
Record the new conditions on the calibration record.
Done when the leakage-derived conditions are drafted into the rule set.
verify: Compare the new conditions against the leakage trigger-gap causes.
Pass when every trigger-gap cause is addressed by a new condition.

steps.title: Back-test the revised rule set against the prior period
sop: Run the revised rule set against the prior period population.
Compare candidate volume and precision against the current rule set.
Record the back-test result on the calibration record.
Done when the back-test result is recorded before promotion.
verify: Check the calibration record for a back-test result dated before promotion.
Pass when the back-test predates the promotion date.

steps.title: Version the rule set and record the approver and go-live date
sop: Assign a new rule set version to the revised rules.
Record the approver name and the go-live date.
Publish the version so scored batches remain traceable.
Done when the version, approver and go-live date are recorded.
verify: Read the deployed rule version against the calibration record.
Pass when the deployed version matches the approved calibration version.

generic.Defined scope/population: Recovery performance metrics across every line of business and recovery type in the portfolio.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Gross recovered, net recovered, pursuit cost, referral volume and closure counts are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total net recovered in the pack reconciles to the ledger recovery credits for the period.

Split by line of business and recovery type.
Record the figures in the metrics pack.

steps.title: Compile referral volume, open files and closure counts

Record the counts in the metrics pack.
Done when the pipeline counts are compiled into the pack.

steps.title: Reconcile net recovered to the ledger recovery credits
sop: Compare compiled net recovered against ledger recovery credits for the period.

Done when net recovered reconciles to the ledger.
verify: Read the reconciliation variance on the pack.

steps.title: Include arbitration win rate and average award

Done when the arbitration metrics appear in the pack.
verify: Recompute the average award percentage from awards and filed amounts.

steps.title: Version and date the pack for consistent comparison
sop: Assign a version number and stamp the data cut-off date on the pack.
Note any restated prior-period figures and the reason.
Store the versioned pack against the reporting period.
Done when the pack is versioned and dated.
verify: Open the pack and read the version and cut-off date.
Pass when both are stamped on the pack.

steps.title: Issue the pack to the recovery unit and leadership
sop: Publish the pack in the payment/subrogation system reporting area.
Notify the recovery unit and claims leadership of availability.

verify: Retrieve the published pack for the reporting period.

generic.Defined scope/population: Recovery, leakage and cycle-time data extracted from the recovery management system.

steps.title: Pull the joined recovery dataset

sop: Compare the extract row count against the recovery system file count.

Pass when both are present on the saved extract.

steps.title: Release the extract for metrics compilation
sop: Review the extract completeness and data gap flags.
Release the extract to the metrics compilation step.
Record the release decision and any caveats.

verify: Check the release record for a completeness review.

generic.Defined scope/population: Recovery improvement recommendations derived from leakage and benchmark findings.
generic.In-scope period: Findings from the completed reporting period feeding the current recommendation cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Finding reference, expected uplift, effort or cost, owner and decision are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recommendations presented equal the findings ranked for leadership decision.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Recommendation pack stored with the presentation date and the findings version cited.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deferred recommendations are logged with the deferral reason and a return date.
generic.Test population: Every recommendation in the pack presented to claims leadership.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every recommendation is tied to a quantified leakage or variance finding.
generic.Exception handling path: Recommendations without a quantified finding are returned for analysis before presentation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Presented when each item shows uplift, owner and a recorded approve, defer or reject decision.
generic.Evidence location: Recommendation pack in the claim file repository for the recommendation cycle.

steps.title: Tie every recommendation to a quantified finding
sop: Read the leakage analysis and benchmark variances for the period.
Link each recommendation to a specific quantified finding.
Reject any recommendation resting only on opinion.
Done when every recommendation cites a quantified finding.
verify: Check each recommendation for a cited finding reference.
Pass when no recommendation is left without a cited finding.

steps.title: State the expected annual uplift and the effort or cost
sop: Estimate the annual recovery uplift for each recommendation.
Estimate the effort or cost required to deliver it.
Record both figures against the recommendation.
Done when every recommendation shows uplift and effort or cost.
verify: Check each recommendation for an uplift and a cost figure.
Pass when both figures appear for every recommendation.

steps.title: Rank the recommendations by value
sop: Rank the recommendations so the highest-value change appears first.
Show the ranking basis alongside the list.
Record the ranked list in the pack.
Done when the recommendations are ranked by value in the pack.
verify: Read the pack order against the recorded uplift figures.
Pass when the order follows the recorded uplift ranking.

steps.title: Name the accountable owner and the system or process to change
sop: Name an accountable owner for each recommendation.
Name the system or process the change touches.
Record both against the recommendation.
Done when every recommendation names an owner and a target system or process.
verify: Check each recommendation for an owner and a target.
Pass when both are named for every recommendation.

steps.title: Present the pack to claims leadership
sop: Present the ranked recommendations to claims leadership.
Take questions and capture challenge on the uplift estimates.
Record the presentation date and attendees.
Done when the pack is presented and attendees recorded.
verify: Check the pack record for a presentation date and attendee list.
Pass when both are recorded.

steps.title: Record the decision per item with date and decision maker
sop: Record approve, defer or reject against each recommendation.
Record the decision date and the decision maker name.
Store the decided pack in the claim file repository.
Done when every item carries a recorded decision.
verify: Filter the recommendation list for items with no decision.
Pass when the filter returns zero items.

generic.Defined scope/population: Net recovery results by accident year and recovery type reported to actuarial.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period with a stated data cut-off date on the submission.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Gross recovered, recovery expense, net recovered, accident year and recovery type are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reported net recovery reconciles to the general ledger recovery credits for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Submission stored with cut-off date, version and any restatement of prior periods noted.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Timing differences against the ledger are noted on the submission with the amount.
generic.Test population: All recoveries booked in the period plus open receivables and expected future recoveries.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero submissions issued before reconciliation to the ledger recovery credits is complete.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled amounts are held from the submission and escalated to the close team.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reported when the split by accident year and recovery type is complete and reconciled.
generic.Evidence location: Actuarial recovery submission for the period in the enterprise data warehouse output area.

steps.title: Report gross recovered, expense and net by accident year
sop: Compile gross recovered, recovery expense and net recovered per accident year.
Split further by line of business.
Record the figures on the submission.
Done when the three figures are compiled by accident year and line.
verify: Recompute net recovered as gross less expense for one accident year.
Pass when the recomputation matches the reported figure.

steps.title: Split recoveries by type so development patterns stay distinct
sop: Split subrogation, salvage, deductible and reinsurance recoveries separately.
Avoid mixing types that develop differently.
Record the split on the submission.
Done when the four recovery types are reported separately.
verify: Sum the four type splits against the total recovered.
Pass when the splits total the reported recovery.

steps.title: Include open receivables and expected future recoveries
sop: Include open recovery receivables at the cut-off date.
Include expected future recoveries on open pursued files.
Record both to support reserve credit setting.
Done when open and expected recoveries appear on the submission.
verify: Compare open receivables on the submission against the ageing report.
Pass when the two figures agree at the cut-off.

steps.title: Reconcile the reported net recovery to the ledger
sop: Compare the reported net recovery to the general ledger recovery credits.
Note any timing difference with its amount and cause.
Hold the submission until the reconciliation is complete.
Done when the reconciliation is complete and noted.
verify: Read the reconciliation note on the submission.
Pass when the variance is nil or explained as a timing difference.

steps.title: State the data cut-off and any restatement
sop: State the data cut-off date on the face of the submission.
Note any restatement of prior periods and the reason.
Version the submission for traceability.
Done when the cut-off and any restatement are stated on the submission.
verify: Open the submission and read the cut-off date and version.
Pass when both are stated on the face of the submission.

steps.title: Issue the submission to actuarial
sop: Issue the reconciled submission to the actuarial team.
Record the issue date and the recipient on the submission record.
Store the submission in the warehouse output area.
Done when the submission is issued and the issue date recorded.
verify: Compare the issue date against the reconciliation completion date.
Pass when the submission was issued only after reconciliation completed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Salvage, collections and panel legal vendors serving the recovery unit under contracted SLAs.
generic.In-scope period: Vendor performance across the completed scoring period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Vendor name, SLA metric, actual result, disallowed items and remediation status are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Vendors scored equal the active vendors on the approved panel for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scorecard stored with the scoring period, preparer name and the invoice data version used.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Vendors with insufficient volume to score are logged with the reason and a review date.
generic.Test population: All active salvage, collections and legal vendors used in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero vendors missing an SLA metric without a recorded remediation action.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed scores route to the vendor manager before the scorecard is published.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assigned when every vendor category is scored against its contracted SLA metrics.
generic.Evidence location: Vendor scorecard in the legal matter management system for the scoring period.

steps.title: Score salvage vendors on realised value and speed
sop: Compare realised salvage value against expected value per assignment.
Measure days from assignment to sale for each vendor.
Record both metrics on the salvage section of the scorecard.
Done when every salvage vendor is scored on value and speed.
verify: Check each active salvage vendor for both metrics.
Pass when both metrics appear for every active salvage vendor.

steps.title: Score collections agencies on gross, net and recovery rate
sop: Measure gross collected and net after contingency fee per agency.
Compute the recovery rate on balances referred.
Record all three on the collections section of the scorecard.
Done when every collections agency is scored on the three metrics.
verify: Recompute the recovery rate from referred and collected balances.
Pass when the recomputation matches the scored figure.

steps.title: Score panel legal firms on cycle time, spend and outcome
sop: Measure matter cycle time and spend against budget per firm.
Measure billing-guideline compliance and outcome value achieved.
Record the four measures on the legal section of the scorecard.
Done when every panel firm is scored on the four measures.
verify: Check each panel firm for all four legal measures.
Pass when all four appear for every active panel firm.

steps.title: Cross-check invoices against the billing guidelines
sop: Sample vendor invoices against the contracted billing guidelines.
Record disallowed line items and their value per vendor.
Feed the disallowed value into the vendor score.
Done when disallowed items are recorded per vendor.
verify: Compare disallowed items recorded against the invoice review sample.
Pass when every disallowed item in the sample appears on the scorecard.

steps.title: Publish the scorecard to each vendor
sop: Publish each vendor scorecard through the vendor management channel.
Record the publication date and the recipient contact.
Store the scorecard in the legal matter management system.
Done when every scored vendor has received its scorecard.
verify: Check each scored vendor for a publication record.
Pass when every scored vendor holds a publication record.

steps.title: Record a remediation plan where an SLA metric is missed
sop: Identify vendors missing any contracted SLA metric.
Agree a remediation action with an owner and a review date.
Record the plan against the vendor scorecard.
Done when every missed SLA metric holds a remediation action.
verify: Filter vendors missing an SLA metric for a remediation action.
Pass when every such vendor holds a recorded remediation action.
